question_english: Which of the following statements best describes the primary scope and applicability of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?
options_english: They apply exclusively to central public sector enterprises and statutory corporations.
They serve purely as non-binding advisory guidelines for state government expenditures.
They regulate the monetary policy operations of the Reserve Bank of India.
They apply to all Ministries and Departments of the Government of India, including their attached and subordinate offices.
explanation_english: According to Rule 1 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, these rules constitute a comprehensive compendium of executive orders and administrative instructions issued by the Ministry of Finance (Department of Expenditure). They apply to all Ministries and Departments of the Government of India, as well as their attached and subordinate offices, and to autonomous bodies except to the extent that separate financial rules have been framed by them and approved by the Government. GFR sets standard procedures for public financial management, procurement of goods and services, budgeting, grants-in-aid, and contract management across the Central Government framework.
explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 1 के अनुसार, ये नियम वित्त मंत्रालय (व्यय विभाग) द्वारा जारी कार्यकारी आदेशों और प्रशासनिक निर्देशों का एक व्यापक संग्रह हैं। ये नियम भारत सरकार के सभी मंत्रालयों, विभागों तथा उनके संलग्न (attached) और अधीनस्थ (subordinate) कार्यालयों पर अनिवार्य रूप से लागू होते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त, ये स्वायत्त निकायों पर भी लागू होते हैं, जब तक कि उनके स्वयं के वित्तीय नियम सरकार द्वारा अनुमोदित न किए गए हों। राज्य सरकारें अपने स्वयं के वित्तीय नियमों से संचालित होती हैं, अतः GFR प्रत्यक्षतः उन पर बाध्यकारी नहीं हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) They are applicable to all Ministries and Departments of the Government of India and its attached and subordinate offices.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Departments of the Government of India and its attached and subordinate offices. The General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017 are a comprehensive set of administrative instructions issued by the Ministry of Finance to govern public finances. These rules apply universally to all Central Government Ministries, Departments, and their subordinate or attached offices. Unless specific exemptions are sanctioned, every administrative unit under the executive framework must strictly adhere to these prescribed standards.

question_english: A newly appointed Principal of a Delhi Government school intends to utilize Vidyalaya Kalyan Samiti (VKS) funds for carrying out minor school repairs. Under the General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, how must the Principal ensure compliance prior to sanctioning the expenditure?
explanation_english: As the Head of Office (HOO) and Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO), a school Principal is custodian of public funds. Even when utilizing specialized institutional funds such as the Vidyalaya Kalyan Samiti (VKS) or school development grants, the fundamental principles of financial propriety (Rule 21 of GFR 2017) and public procurement standards (Rule 144 of GFR 2017) must be strictly followed. The Principal must ensure that the expenditure does not exceed budgetary ceilings, that competitive procurement/quotation procedures (or GeM guidelines) are observed, and that every financial commitment represents prudent stewardship of public money without favoritism or arbitrary deviation.
explanation_hindi: कार्यालय प्रमुख (Head of Office) और आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) के रूप में स्कूल के प्रधानाचार्य सरकारी धन के संरक्षक होते हैं। विद्यालय कल्याण समिति (VKS) या स्कूल विकास अनुदान जैसी विशेष निधियों का उपयोग करते समय भी सामान्य वित्तीय नियम 2017 के नियम 21 (वित्तीय औचित्य के मानक - Standards of Financial Propriety) और नियम 144 (सार्वजनिक खरीद के मूलभूत सिद्धांत) का कड़ाई से पालन किया जाना अनिवार्य है। कोई भी विशेष समिति निधि GFR के मूलभूत सिद्धांतों से छूट प्रदान नहीं करती है; पारदर्शिता, दक्षता, प्रतिस्पर्धा और औचित्य बनाए रखना अनिवार्य है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) By adhering to the fundamental principles of public buying and financial propriety as mandated by GFR.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: of public buying and financial propriety as mandated by GFR. When utilizing public funds for repair work or maintenance, financial rules dictate that every institutional administrator must ensure compliance with established standards. Utilizing special grants or local committee funds does not grant an exemption from fundamental procurement regulations. Sanctioning official expenditure requires upholding strict principles of financial propriety, maintaining transparency, and following standard public procurement procedures at all times.

question_english: Which department within the Ministry of Finance is responsible for framing, revising, and issuing the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?

explanation_english: The Department of Expenditure under the Ministry of Finance is the nodal authority responsible for overseeing the public financial management system and expenditure control in the Central Government. question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the applicability and scope of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017:
I. The rules are deemed applicable to Autonomous Bodies except to the extent that their own specific rules have been approved by the Government.
II. GFR 2017 completely supersedes all previous editions of the General Financial Rules.
III. State Governments are statutorily bound to adopt GFR 2017 without any modification.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
explanation_english: Statement I is correct: Rule 1 of GFR 2017 provides that these rules are deemed applicable to Autonomous Bodies except to the extent that separate financial rules have been framed by them with the approval of the Central Government. Statement II is correct: GFR 2017 supersedes GFR 2005 and all earlier editions. Statement III is incorrect: Under the federal constitutional structure (Articles 282 and 283), State Governments operate under their own State Financial Codes and rules enacted by state legislatures; they are not legally bound to adopt the Central Government's GFR 2017, although they may draw inspiration from it.
explanation_hindi: कथन I सही है: GFR 2017 के नियम 1 के अनुसार, ये नियम केंद्र सरकार के स्वायत्त निकायों पर भी लागू माने जाते हैं, बशर्ते उन निकायों ने सरकार के अनुमोदन से अपने अलग नियम न बनाए हों। कथन II सही है: GFR 2017 ने पूर्ववर्ती GFR 2005 और सभी पुराने संस्करणों को पूरी तरह से प्रतिस्थापित (supersede) कर दिया है। कथन III गलत है: भारत के संघीय ढांचे (अनुच्छेद 282 और 283) के तहत राज्य सरकारों की अपनी वित्तीय नियमावलियां (State Financial Rules/Codes) होती हैं; राज्य सरकारें केंद्र के GFR 2017 को बिना संशोधन अपनाने के लिए कानूनी रूप से बाध्य नहीं हैं। अतः केवल I और II सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The General Financial Rules 2017 automatically apply to autonomous bodies unless those organizations have framed their own specific financial rules approved by the Central Government. Furthermore, the 2017 framework completely replaced and superseded all pre- existing versions of financial rules. However, state governments operate under their own autonomous constitutional powers and financial guidelines, meaning central financial rules are not mandatory for them.

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The General Financial Rules, 2017 permit individual Ministries and Departments to issue departmental instructions governing their financial procedures.
Reason (R): Departmental instructions must broadly conform to the General Financial Rules and must not violate the core principles of public procurement.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
explanation_english: Under Rule 7 and Rule 8 of GFR 2017, Ministries and Departments are authorized to issue departmental regulations, manuals, and instructions to meet their specialized functional and administrative needs. However, this flexibility is strictly conditional: such subsidiary instructions must not run contrary to or dilute the fundamental principles laid down in the GFR, particularly the standards of financial propriety, accountability, transparency, and public procurement. Thus, Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are both true, and (R) accurately explains why departmental instructions are permissible only within the bounded framework of the GFR.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 7 और 8 के अंतर्गत मंत्रालयों और विभागों को अपनी विशिष्ट प्रशासनिक आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के लिए विभागीय नियमावली या निर्देश जारी करने का अधिकार है (अभिकथन A सही है)। परंतु यह अधिकार इस अनिवार्य शर्त के अधीन है कि ऐसे विभागीय निर्देश GFR के प्रावधानों, वित्तीय औचित्य और सार्वजनिक खरीद के बुनियादी सिद्धांतों के विरुद्ध नहीं हो सकते (कारण R सही है)। कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की पुष्टि करता है कि विभागीय निर्देशों की वैधता GFR की मूल भावना के अनुरूप होने पर ही निर्भर है। अतः (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Individual ministries and departments possess the administrative authority to issue supplementary instructions to address their specialized operational needs. However, these localized instructions cannot override or contradict the overarching General Financial Rules. They must strictly align with core principles of public buying and financial management, ensuring that localized adaptations preserve essential standards of transparency, fairness, accountability, and public economy across operations.

question_english: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding the modification or relaxation of the provisions of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?
options_english: No rule may be modified or relaxed without the express concurrence of the Ministry of Finance.
Any system or financial procedure not covered by these rules requires the prior approval of the Ministry of Finance.
Subordinate offices possess autonomous authority to relax GFR rules during administrative emergencies.
The provisions of GFR must be strictly complied with while incurring expenditure from public funds.
explanation_english: According to Rule 7 and Rule 8 of GFR 2017, no rule may be modified, relaxed, or waived without the prior concurrence of the Ministry of Finance (Department of Expenditure). Subordinate and field offices (such as schools, directorates, or branch offices) possess zero discretionary authority to independently relax or waive any GFR rules, even during operational emergencies. If an unforeseen situation or emergent procurement arises, emergency provisions prescribed within the existing rules (e.g., Rule 166 for single-source procurement during emergencies) must be followed, or formal sanction from the competent authority / Ministry of Finance must be obtained.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 7 और 8 के तहत, किसी भी नियम में संशोधन, शिथिलीकरण (relaxation) अथवा छूट देने का अनन्य अधिकार केवल वित्त मंत्रालय (व्यय विभाग) के पास सुरक्षित है। अधीनस्थ या क्षेत्रीय कार्यालयों (जैसे सरकारी स्कूल या स्थानीय कार्यालय) को आपातकालीन स्थितियों में भी GFR के नियमों को स्वतंत्र रूप से शिथिल या अनदेखा करने का कोई अधिकार नहीं है। यदि कोई आपात स्थिति उत्पन्न होती है, तो भी GFR के तहत निर्धारित आपातकालीन प्रक्रियाओं (जैसे नियम 166 के तहत खरीद) या सक्षम प्राधिकारी के पूर्व अनुमोदन का पालन करना अनिवार्य होता है। अतः कथन C गलत (और सही उत्तर) है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Subordinate offices can independently relax the rules in emergency situations.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: the rules in emergency situations. Subordinate offices do not possess independent administrative power to modify, relax, or waive any provision of the General Financial Rules, even during operational emergencies. The Ministry of Finance retains absolute authority regarding any relaxation or structural modification of financial guidelines. Subordinate authorities must always seek formal concurrence from the central finance authority whenever an unlisted administrative system or procedure is being proposed.

question_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR) 2017 के किस विशिष्ट नियम के तहत वित्तीय प्रबंधन और नियंत्रण (Financial Management and Control) की सामान्य प्रणाली को स्पष्ट रूप से विस्तृत किया गया है?
options_hindi: नियम 12 (Rule 12)
नियम 1 (Rule 1)
नियम 21 (Rule 21)
नियम 65 (Rule 65)
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017
subject: UPSC Principal Paper
question_english: Under which specific rule of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 is the general system of financial management and internal control explicitly delineated?
options_english: Rule 12
Rule 1
Rule 21
Rule 65
explanation_english: Rule 12 of GFR 2017 deals specifically with the 'General System of Financial Management and Control'. It states that the Head of a Department is responsible for enforcing financial order, economy, and strict internal controls within their department and subordinate offices. Rule 1 deals with the short title and commencement; Rule 21 specifies the 'Standards of Financial Propriety'; and Rule 65 pertains to communication of budget allocations. Under Rule 12, administrators must ensure that adequate internal checks and controls exist against fraud, irregular spending, and financial leakages.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 का 'नियम 12' (Rule 12) वित्तीय प्रबंधन और नियंत्रण की सामान्य प्रणाली (General System of Financial Management and Control) को परिभाषित करता है। यह नियम प्रशासनिक विभाग/विभाग प्रमुख को वित्तीय अनुशासन लागू करने, मितव्ययिता सुनिश्चित करने और किसी भी प्रकार की वित्तीय अनियमितता को रोकने के लिए उत्तरदायी बनाता है। (जबकि नियम 1 प्रारंभिक शीर्षक से, नियम 21 वित्तीय औचित्य के मानकों से, और नियम 65 बजट आवंटन की सूचना से संबंधित है)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Rule 12

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Rule 12 of the General Financial Rules explicitly outlines the framework governing financial management and internal control within government departments. It assigns direct responsibility to the administrative ministry to maintain proper financial order, prevent irregularities, and ensure effective utilization of funds. This rule mandates that every head of department establish robust internal checking systems to safeguard public resources continuously.

question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी इकाई सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR) 2017 के प्रावधानों से स्वतः बाध्य नहीं है, जब तक कि वह इसे स्पष्ट रूप से स्वीकार (adopt) न कर ले?
options_hindi: किसी केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के संलग्न कार्यालय (Attached Offices)
किसी केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के अधीनस्थ कार्यालय (Subordinate Offices)
केंद्र सरकार के विभाग (Central Government Departments)
राज्य सरकार के विभाग (State Government Departments)
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017
subject: UPSC Principal Paper
question_english: Which of the following entities is NOT automatically governed by the provisions of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 unless expressly adopted?
options_english: Attached offices of a Central Ministry
Subordinate offices of a Central Ministry
Central Government Departments
State Government Departments
explanation_english: The General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 are framed and issued by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, under executive powers for transactions relating to the Consolidated Fund of India and the Public Account of India. All Central Government Ministries, Departments, attached offices, and subordinate offices are automatically and statutorily bound by GFR 2017. Conversely, State Government departments are sovereign administrative units governed by their respective State Financial Codes and rules enacted pursuant to Articles 202-207 and 283 of the Constitution. Therefore, GFR 2017 does not automatically apply to State Government departments unless specifically adopted by an executive order of that State.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 केंद्र सरकार के वित्त मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी किए गए हैं और ये भारत की संचित निधि तथा लोक लेखा से संबंधित लेन-देन पर स्वतः लागू होते हैं। केंद्र सरकार के सभी मंत्रालय, विभाग, संलग्न कार्यालय और अधीनस्थ कार्यालय इससे अनिवार्य रूप से बंधे हैं। इसके विपरीत, राज्य सरकारों के अपने अलग वित्तीय नियम और संहिताएं (State Financial Codes) होती हैं। राज्य सरकार के विभाग केंद्रीय GFR से स्वतः बाध्य नहीं हैं, जब तक कि संबंधित राज्य सरकार औपचारिक अधिसूचना द्वारा इसे स्वीकार न कर ले।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) State Government Departments

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: State Government departments are governed by their respective state financial codes and rules framed under constitutional powers. Consequently, central General Financial Rules do not apply to state administrative units unless a state government explicitly decides to adopt them through formal notification. In contrast, all central departments, including their attached and subordinate offices, are automatically bound by the central financial rules framework.

question_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम 2017 के नियम 2 में दी गई परिभाषाओं के अनुसार, "सक्षम प्राधिकारी" (Competent Authority) का क्या अर्थ है?
options_hindi: वेतन मैट्रिक्स में लेवल 10 से ऊपर मूल वेतन प्राप्त करने वाला कोई भी राजपत्रित अधिकारी।
वह प्राधिकारी जिसे इन नियमों द्वारा या इनके अधीन वित्तीय शक्तियां प्रत्यायोजित की गई हैं।
मंत्रालय के प्रधान लेखा कार्यालय द्वारा नियुक्त आंतरिक लेखा परीक्षक।
वैधानिक प्रावधानों के तहत गठित राज्य वित्त आयोग।
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017
subject: UPSC Principal Paper
question_english: According to the definitions provided in Rule 2 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, what does the term "Competent Authority" signify?
options_english: Any Gazetted Officer drawing basic pay at or above Level 10 of the Pay Matrix.
An authority to whom financial or administrative powers are delegated by or under the rules.
The internal auditor designated by the Principal Accounts Office of a Ministry.
A State Finance Commission constituted under statutory enactments.
explanation_english: Under Rule 2(j) / Rule 2 definitions of GFR 2017, 'Competent Authority' means, in respect of the power to be exercised under any of these rules, the President or such other authority to whom the power is delegated by or under these rules, Delegations of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 1978, or by any other general or special orders of the Government. A competent authority is legally empowered to accord administrative approval, expenditure sanction, and enter into contracts within the limits of the delegated authority.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 2 के अनुसार, 'सक्षम प्राधिकारी' (Competent Authority) से तात्पर्य राष्ट्रपति अथवा ऐसे किसी अन्य प्राधिकारी से है, जिसे इन नियमों के अधीन, या वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियम (DFPR), 1978 के अधीन, अथवा सरकार के किसी सामान्य या विशेष आदेश द्वारा वित्तीय या प्रशासनिक शक्तियां सौंपी (प्रत्यायोजित) गई हैं। सक्षम प्राधिकारी अपनी प्रत्यायोजित वित्तीय सीमा के भीतर ही प्रशासनिक स्वीकृति एवं वित्तीय व्यय की मंजूरी दे सकता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) An authority to whom powers are delegated by or under the rules.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: by or under the rules. In the context of financial administration, a competent authority refers to any officer or body explicitly vested with executive or financial powers under statutory provisions or delegated rules. Such authorization enables the designated official to grant administrative sanctions, approve financial commitments, and execute contracts. Executive powers are strictly confined to the specific monetary limits and conditions defined within the statutory delegation orders.

question_hindi: GFR 2017 के अनुसार, "सार्वजनिक धन" (Public Money) में निम्नलिखित में से क्या शामिल नहीं है?
options_hindi: प्रत्यक्ष और अप्रत्यक्ष कर संग्रह के माध्यम से सरकार द्वारा प्राप्त राजस्व।
बाजार उधारी और ट्रेजरी बिलों के माध्यम से सरकार द्वारा जुटाए गए ऋण।
किसी सरकारी कर्मचारी द्वारा व्यक्तिगत हैसियत से प्राप्त निजी दान/उपहार।
भविष्य निधि (PF) सहित भारत के लोक खाते में प्राप्त धनराशियां।
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017
subject: UPSC Principal Paper
question_english: According to the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, the term "Public Money" does NOT include which of the following?
options_english: Revenues realized by the Government through direct and indirect taxes.
Loans raised by the Government through treasury bills and market borrowings.
Private donations or gifts received by an employee in an individual personal capacity.
Moneys credited into the Public Account of India, including provident funds and small savings.
explanation_english: Under Rule 2 of GFR 2017, 'Public Money' or 'Public Funds' means the Consolidated Fund of India, the Contingency Fund of India, and the Public Account of India, comprising all revenues, market borrowings, loan recoveries, statutory deposits, and remittances. Moneys received or held by a government servant in a strictly private or individual personal capacity are not public funds. Acceptance of personal gifts is governed by CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964, but such amounts do not form part of Government accounts or Public Money.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 2 के अनुसार, 'सार्वजनिक धन' (Public Money) का अर्थ भारत की संचित निधि (Consolidated Fund of India), भारत की आकस्मिकता निधि (Contingency Fund of India) और भारत के लोक खाते (Public Account of India) में आने वाले समस्त राजस्व, ऋण, बाजार उधारी, भविष्य निधि जमा और प्रेषणों से है। किसी कर्मचारी द्वारा अपनी व्यक्तिगत हैसियत से प्राप्त निजी दान या राशि सार्वजनिक धन का हिस्सा नहीं होती है (यद्यपि ऐसा उपहार स्वीकार करना आचरण नियमों द्वारा विनियमित होता है)। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Private donations received by an employee in personal capacity.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: in personal capacity. Public money encompasses all official revenues, tax collections, market borrowings, loans, and statutory deposits credited to the Consolidated Fund of India or the Public Account of India. Personal monetary gifts or private donations accepted by a government employee in an individual capacity are entirely outside the statutory domain of public money, although receiving personal gifts remains subject to separate conduct rules.

question_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम 2017 के ढांचे के तहत "कार्यालय प्रमुख" (Head of Office) को आमतौर पर कैसे घोषित किया जाता है?
options_hindi: स्थानीय नगर निगम परिषद द्वारा पारित एक औपचारिक प्रस्ताव द्वारा।
किसी कार्यालय में वरिष्ठता के आधार पर स्वतः पदोन्नति आदेश द्वारा।
भारत के नियंत्रक और महालेखापरीक्षक (CAG) द्वारा जारी एक विशिष्ट अधिसूचना द्वारा।
DFPR के तहत औपचारिक आदेश के माध्यम से विभागाध्यक्ष (Head of Department) द्वारा।
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017
subject: UPSC Principal Paper
question_english: Under the framework of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 and DFPR, how is a "Head of Office" officially declared?
options_english: Through a formal resolution adopted by the local municipal body.
By an automatic seniority-based order within a particular office establishment.
Through a statutory notification issued by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
By the Head of Department (HOD) issuing a formal administrative order under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR).
explanation_english: Under Rule 2 of GFR 2017 and Rule 3(f) of the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 1978, a 'Head of Office' means a Gazetted Officer declared as such by a Head of Department (HOD) under Rule 14 of DFPR. In schools, the Director of Education (who acts as HOD) formally declares the school Principal/Vice-Principal as the Head of Office (HOO), empowering them to exercise specified administrative and financial powers, sanction contingent expenditure, and operate official establishment accounts.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 2 और वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियम (DFPR), 1978 के नियम 3(f) तथा नियम 14 के अनुसार, 'कार्यालय प्रमुख' (Head of Office - HOO) उस राजपत्रित अधिकारी को घोषित किया जाता है जिसे विभागाध्यक्ष (Head of Department - HOD) द्वारा एक औपचारिक लिखित आदेश द्वारा ऐसा घोषित किया गया हो। उदाहरण के लिए, शिक्षा निदेशालय में शिक्षा निदेशक (विभागाध्यक्ष) द्वारा स्कूल के प्रधानाचार्य (Principal) को कार्यालय प्रमुख घोषित किया जाता है, जिससे उन्हें दैनिक आकस्मिक व्यय स्वीकृत करने तथा प्रशासनिक शक्तियां प्रयोग करने का अधिकार प्राप्त होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) By the Head of Department through a formal order under DFPR.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: formal order under DFPR. A Head of Office is formally declared by the competent Head of Department issuing a specific administrative order under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules. This declaration grants designated administrative and financial responsibilities to a gazetted officer, enabling them to manage day-to-day office expenditure, authorize routine administrative bills, maintain official accounts, and manage local establishment matters for that specific government unit.

question_hindi:
GFR के तहत परिभाषित "आकस्मिक व्यय" (Contingent Expenditure) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. इसमें कार्यालय के प्रबंधन के लिए आवश्यक सभी प्रासंगिक (incidental) और अन्य व्यय शामिल हैं।
II. इसमें स्थायी कर्मचारियों के नियमित वेतन भुगतान शामिल हैं।
III. इसमें भंडारों (stores) पर होने वाला व्यय शामिल नहीं होता है।
IV. इसमें कार्यालय फर्नीचर की खरीद और छोटी-मोटी मरम्मत पर होने वाला व्यय शामिल है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
options_hindi: केवल I और II
केवल I और IV
केवल II, III और IV
केवल I, III और IV
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017
subject: UPSC Principal Paper
question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding "Contingent Expenditure" as defined under the General Financial Rules (GFR):
I. It includes all incidental and operational expenses necessary for the routine management of an office.
II. It encompasses regular monthly salary and allowance disbursements to permanent staff.
III. It strictly excludes expenditure incurred on all types of stores.
IV. It includes expenditure incurred on purchasing office furniture and carrying out minor repairs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I and IV only
II, III and IV only
I, III and IV only
explanation_english: Under GFR and Government accounting rules, 'Contingent Expenditure' (or Contingencies) means that class of expenditure which comprises incidental and other expenses incurred on the management of an office (e.g., stationery, postage, minor repairs, office furniture within delegated limits, electricity/water bills, freight). It explicitly excludes establishment charges (salaries, allowances, and honoraria of regular government servants). Minor store purchases necessary for office maintenance fall within contingencies. Hence, Statement I is correct, Statement II is incorrect, Statement III is incorrect (office stores/stationery are part of contingencies), and Statement IV is correct. Thus, I and IV are the correct statements.
explanation_hindi: GFR और सरकारी लेखा नियमों के अनुसार, 'आकस्मिक व्यय' (Contingent Expenditure) से तात्पर्य कार्यालय के दैनिक संचालन और प्रबंधन के लिए आवश्यक प्रासंगिक खर्चों से है। इसमें डाक टिकट, स्टेशनरी, बिजली-पानी के बिल, छोटी मरम्मतें और निर्धारित सीमा के भीतर कार्यालय फर्नीचर आदि शामिल होते हैं (कथन I और IV सही हैं)। आकस्मिक व्यय में नियमित कर्मचारियों के वेतन और भत्ते (Establishment Charges) शामिल नहीं होते (कथन II गलत है)। कार्यालय संचालन हेतु आवश्यक छोटे भंडार (stores) आकस्मिक व्यय का ही भाग होते हैं, अतः कथन III भी गलत है। इसलिए सही उत्तर 'केवल I और IV' है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Contingent expenditure comprises all incidental administrative expenses necessary for the routine operational management and functioning of a government establishment. It includes costs incurred for office stationery, minor structural repairs, utility payments, and office furniture procurement. However, regular establishment charges like fixed salaries, permanent staff allowances, and major public store acquisitions are strictly excluded from the scope of contingent expenditure.

question_hindi: GFR 2017 की परिभाषाओं के तहत निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प "स्थानीय निकाय" (Local Body) का सही वर्णन करता है?
options_hindi: केवल राज्यों के घोषित महानगरों में स्थापित नगर निगम।
कोई भी ऐसा प्राधिकारी जो स्थानीय या नगरपालिका निधि का प्रबंधन करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से हकदार हो।
स्थानीय जिला स्तर पर कार्यरत कोई भी पंजीकृत गैर-सरकारी संगठन (NGO)।
केवल राज्य ग्रामीण विकास अधिनियमों के तहत काम करने वाले पंचायती राज संस्थान।
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017
subject: UPSC Principal Paper
question_english: Which of the following correctly describes a "Local Body" under the definitions of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?
options_english: Only municipal corporations established in notified metropolitan cities.
Any authority legally entitled to, or entrusted by the Government with, the control or management of a local or municipal fund.
Any registered non-governmental organization operating at the grassroots district level.
Only Panchayati Raj Institutions functioning under State Panchayati Raj statutes.
explanation_english: Under Rule 2 of GFR 2017, a 'Local Body' is defined as an authority legally entitled to, or entrusted by the Government with, the control or management of a local or municipal fund. This broad statutory definition encompasses municipal corporations, municipalities, notified area committees, cantonment boards, zilla parishads, and gram panchayats. These bodies possess statutory powers to collect designated taxes/fees, receive grants-in-aid from the Government, and administer public funds for civic functions within their jurisdictional territories.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 2 के अनुसार, 'स्थानीय निकाय' (Local Body) से तात्पर्य ऐसे किसी भी प्राधिकारी से है जो सरकार द्वारा किसी स्थानीय या नगरपालिका निधि (Local or Municipal Fund) के नियंत्रण या प्रबंधन के लिए कानूनी रूप से अधिकृत अथवा सौंपा गया हो। इसमें नगर निगम, नगर पालिका परिषद, छावनी बोर्ड और पंचायती राज संस्थाएं सभी शामिल हैं। यह परिभाषा किसी गैर-सरकारी संगठन (NGO) पर लागू नहीं होती। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Any authority legally entitled to manage a local or municipal fund.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: local or municipal fund. A local body is defined as any statutory or constitutional authority legally entrusted by government legislation with the administration and management of a dedicated local or municipal fund. question_english: Under the General Financial Rules (GFR), a "Drawing and Disbursing Officer" (DDO) is primarily entrusted with which of the following core responsibilities?

Formulating fiscal and monetary policy frameworks for central regulatory bodies.
explanation_english: Under Rule 2 of GFR 2017 and Central Treasury Rules / Receipt and Payment Rules, a 'Drawing and Disbursing Officer' (DDO) is a Gazetted Officer authorized to draw bills and money from the Government Account (via the Pay and Accounts Office or Treasury) and disburse payments to staff, vendors, contractors, and beneficiaries. explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 के नियम 2 और केंद्रीय रसीद एवं भुगतान नियमों (Receipt and Payment Rules) के तहत, 'आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी' (DDO) वह राजपत्रित अधिकारी होता है जिसे वेतन और लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) या ट्रेजरी से सरकारी बिल प्रस्तुत कर धन निकालने (Draw) और उसे संबंधित पक्षों (कर्मचारियों, आपूर्तिकर्ताओं आदि) में विधिवत संवितरित (Disburse) करने का अधिकार प्राप्त होता है। DDO की मुख्य जिम्मेदारियों में बिलों की जांच, रोकड़ बही (Cash Book) का संधारण, TDS कटौती तथा वित्तीय अनियमितताओं को रोकना शामिल है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Drawing money from Government Account and disbursing it to payees.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: and disbursing it to payees. A Drawing and Disbursing Officer is a designated gazetted officer entrusted with the official responsibility of drawing funds from the government treasury or Pay and Accounts Office. The primary duties include preparing disbursement bills, verifying underlying vouchers, making authorized payments to vendors or staff, maintaining the official cash book, and ensuring proper accounting of all cash transactions under their custody.

question_english: The Principal of a Government Boys Senior Secondary School is designated as the Head of Office. A teacher submits a bill for the purchase of classroom teaching aids. Prior to forwarding the bill to the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO) for payment, what is the most appropriate action the Principal must take under GFR rules and DDO responsibilities?
options_english: Verify that expenditure sanction was accorded by the competent authority, confirm physical receipt of items in good condition, and verify entries in the official stock register.
Forward the bill immediately to the Pay and Accounts Office without verifying stock register entries to avoid payment delay.
Direct the teacher to defray the cost from personal funds and seek reimbursement at the close of the financial year.
Forward the bill directly to the Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, for prior clearance.
explanation_english: Under Rule 12, Rule 144, and Rule 207-211 (Procurement and Inventory Management) of GFR 2017, as well as DDO rules, before passing any bill or forwarding it to the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO), the Head of Office / DDO must satisfy themselves that: (i) the expenditure has been sanctioned by the Competent Authority within delegated financial limits; (ii) the items purchased have been physically received in full count and satisfactory working condition; (iii) the non-consumable/consumable articles have been duly entered in the appropriate school Stock Register with the relevant page number and certificate recorded on the invoice bill; and (iv) the rates and arithmetical calculations are correct. Bypassing stock verification is a serious financial irregularity.
explanation_hindi: GFR 2017 (नियम 12, 144 एवं नियम 207-211 भंडार और माल सूची प्रबंधन) तथा DDO नियमावली के अनुसार, वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) को बिल भेजने से पूर्व कार्यालय प्रमुख (प्रधानाचार्य) को अनिवार्य रूप से यह सत्यापित करना होता है कि: 1. खरीद हेतु सक्षम प्राधिकारी से प्रशासनिक व वित्तीय स्वीकृति प्राप्त है; 2. सामान सही मात्रा और गुणवत्ता में प्राप्त हो चुका है; 3. सामान की प्रविष्टि स्कूल के स्टॉक रजिस्टर (उपभोज्य/अनुपभोज्य) में विधिवत कर दी गई है और बिल पर स्टॉक एंट्री का प्रमाण पत्र व पृष्ठ संख्या अंकित कर दी गई है; तथा 4. दरें व गणनाएं सही हैं। स्टॉक सत्यापन के बिना बिल पास करना वित्तीय नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Verify sanction by competent authority and receipt of items in good condition.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: receipt of items in good condition. Before presenting any financial claim to the accounts office, an administrative head acting as the head of office must rigorously verify the underlying documentation. question_english: Which of the following statements correctly defines the scope of a "Subordinate Authority" under the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017?
options_english: A Head of Department operating under direct presidential authority without being subject to standard delegated rules
Non-gazetted administrative and ministerial support personnel (Group C and Group D) within a government office
Any department of the Central Government or any administrative authority exercising financial powers subordinate to the President
Commercial vendors and contractors registered under the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) system
explanation_english:
Under Rule 2(xliii) of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, "Subordinate Authority" is defined as a Department of the Central Government or any authority subordinate to the President of India.

Key administrative and statutory aspects include:
1. Delegation Framework: Under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 1978 and GFR 2017, the President delegates financial and sanctioning powers to various subordinate authorities, including Ministries, Departments, Heads of Departments (HoD), and Heads of Offices (HoO).
2. Application to School Principals: A Government School Principal functioning as Head of Office (HoO) and Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) acts as a subordinate authority. The Principal exercises delegated sanctioning powers within prescribed monetary ceilings (e.g., for office contingencies, school repairs, and local purchases) strictly subordinate to the administrative Ministry/Directorate and the President.
3. Oversight and Accountability: All subordinate authorities are bound by the statutory limits of their financial delegation, budgetary appropriations, and the standards of financial propriety.
explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 2(xliii) के अनुसार, "अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारी" (Subordinate Authority) का तात्पर्य केंद्र सरकार के किसी विभाग या भारत के राष्ट्रपति के अधीनस्थ किसी भी प्राधिकारी से है।

प्रमुख प्रशासनिक एवं वैधानिक बिंदु:
1. शक्तियों का प्रत्यायोजन: वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियम (DFPR), 1978 और GFR 2017 के अंतर्गत, राष्ट्रपति विभिन्न अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारियों—जैसे मंत्रालयों, विभागों, विभागाध्यक्षों (HoD) और कार्यालयाध्यक्षों (HoO)—को वित्तीय स्वीकृतियां जारी करने की शक्तियां सौंपते हैं।
2. विद्यालय प्राचार्य पर अनुप्रयोग: एक सरकारी विद्यालय के प्राचार्य, जो कार्यालयाध्यक्ष (HoO) और आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) के रूप में कार्य करते हैं, एक अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारी के रूप में कार्य करते हैं। प्राचार्य को निर्धारित वित्तीय सीमाओं (जैसे आकस्मिक व्यय, विद्यालय मरम्मत और स्थानीय खरीद) के भीतर वित्तीय स्वीकृतियां देने का अधिकार प्राप्त होता है, जो निदेशालय और राष्ट्रपति के अधीनस्थ होता है।
3. जवाबदेही और सीमाएं: सभी अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारी अपने प्रत्यायोजन आदेशों, बजटीय सीमाओं और वित्तीय औचित्य के नियमों से पूरी तरह बंधे होते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) It includes any authority delegated financial powers subordinate to the President.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: powers subordinate to the President. In administrative and financial terminology, a subordinate authority refers to any officer, administrative body, or organizational head that exercises delegated financial powers subordinate to the President of India. These authorities function within established financial hierarchies, deriving their sanctioning powers from formal delegation rules while remaining subject to oversight, budget limitations, and supervisory control by superior administrative bodies and financial officers.

question_english: Which specific rule of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 codifies the fundamental "Standards of Financial Propriety"?
options_english: Rule 11
Rule 144
Rule 225
Rule 21
explanation_english:
Rule 21 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 explicitly lays down the "Standards of Financial Propriety" (often referred to as the Canons of Financial Propriety) that every public officer managing government funds must strictly observe.

Overview of the Rule:
1. Rule 21 serves as the ethical and legal foundation of public expenditure in India. It mandates that public money must be spent with ordinary prudence, without extravagance, without personal conflict of interest, and not for the exclusive benefit of individuals or groups unless legally backed.
2. Comparison with other cited rules:
   - Rule 11: Governs the collection and receipt of government revenues and dues.
   - Rule 144: Lays down the fundamental principles of public buying and procurement of goods.
   - Rule 225: Pertains to general principles governing Grants-in-Aid to non-governmental bodies.
   - Rule 21: Specifically codifies the Standards of Financial Propriety.
explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 का नियम 21 स्पष्ट रूप से "वित्तीय औचित्य के मानक" (Standards of Financial Propriety) को निर्धारित करता है, जिसे प्रत्येक सरकारी अधिकारी द्वारा सार्वजनिक धन का प्रबंधन करते समय अनिवार्य रूप से देखा जाना चाहिए।

नियम का संक्षिप्त विश्लेषण:
1. नियम 21 भारत में सार्वजनिक व्यय का नैतिक और कानूनी आधार है। यह अधिदेशित करता है कि सरकारी धन को सामान्य विवेक, मितव्ययिता, बिना किसी व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ/हितों के टकराव के खर्च किया जाए।
2. अन्य संदर्भित नियमों की स्थिति:
   - नियम 11: सरकारी राजस्व और बकाए की प्राप्ति एवं संग्रहण से संबंधित है।
   - नियम 144: वस्तुओं की सार्वजनिक खरीद के मौलिक सिद्धांतों को निर्धारित करता है।
   - नियम 225: गैर-सरकारी संस्थाओं को दिए जाने वाले सहायता अनुदान (Grants-in-Aid) के सामान्य सिद्धांतों से संबंधित है।
   - नियम 21: विशेष रूप से वित्तीय औचित्य के मानकों को संहिताबद्ध करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Rule 21

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Rule 21 of the General Financial Rules 2017 details the fundamental standards of financial propriety that every public official must observe. These standards act as statutory moral and administrative guidelines, mandating that officers manage public money with high integrity, enforce strict economy, avoid conflicts of interest, and ensure expenditure does not exceed reasonable necessity for the occasion being funded.

question_english: According to the Standards of Financial Propriety in GFR 2017, every public officer is required to exercise the same degree of vigilance in respect of public expenditure as a person of ordinary prudence would exercise in respect of:
options_english: Corporate funds allocated to a publicly traded commercial company
Discretionary grants sanctioned to a registered philanthropic society
The expenditure of their own personal money
Trust property placed under their official legal guardianship
explanation_english:
Under Rule 21(i) of GFR 2017, the very first canon of financial propriety stipulates:
"Every officer is expected to exercise the same vigilance in respect of expenditure incurred from public moneys as a person of ordinary prudence would exercise in respect of expenditure of his own money."

Key implications for Educational Administrators / Principals:
1. Personal Care and Thrift: Public funds cannot be treated carelessly simply because they are state resources. An administrator must avoid unnecessary luxury, excessive quantities, and inflated pricing.
2. Duty of a DDO: As a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO), a school Principal managing government budget grants, Samagra Shiksha funds, or student activity fees must ensure every rupee spent passes the test of ordinary personal prudence.
explanation_hindi:
GFR 2017 के नियम 21(i) के अंतर्गत, वित्तीय औचित्य का सर्वप्रथम सिद्धांत यह निर्धारित करता है:
"प्रत्येक अधिकारी से यह अपेक्षा की जाती है कि वह सार्वजनिक धन से किए जाने वाले व्यय के संबंध में उतनी ही सतर्कता और विवेक बरतेगा, जितनी सामान्य विवेक वाला व्यक्ति अपने स्वयं के निजी धन के व्यय के संबंध में बरतता है।"

शैक्षिक प्रशासकों/प्राचार्यों के लिए मुख्य निहितार्थ:

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): No authority should exercise its powers of sanctioning expenditure to pass an order which will be directly or indirectly to its own advantage.
Reason (R): The principles of financial propriety strictly prohibit conflict of interest in the management and sanction of public funds.

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
explanation_english:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) correctly explains (A).

1. Legal Basis: Rule 21(iv) of GFR 2017 states: "No authority should exercise its powers of sanctioning expenditure or to pass an order which will be directly or indirectly to its own advantage."
2. Conflict of Interest Doctrine: Public money is held in fiduciary trust. An authority cannot act as both the judge/sanctioning officer and the beneficiary of public expenditure. If a sanction confers personal financial benefit (e.g., sanctioning rent of one's own private building for a school, sanctioning personal allowances beyond entitlements), an explicit conflict of interest arises. Reason (R) directly provides the core administrative and ethical rationale underpinning Assertion (A).
explanation_hindi:

1. वैधानिक आधार: GFR 2017 का नियम 21(iv) निर्धारित करता है: "किसी भी प्राधिकारी को व्यय स्वीकृत करने की अपनी शक्तियों का प्रयोग ऐसा कोई आदेश पारित करने के लिए नहीं करना चाहिए जो प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से उसके अपने लाभ के लिए हो।"
2. हितों के टकराव का सिद्धांत: सार्वजनिक धन एक न्यास (ट्रस्ट) के रूप में धारित होता है। कोई भी सरकारी अधिकारी एक ही समय में व्यय स्वीकृत करने वाला प्राधिकारी और उसका लाभार्थी दोनों नहीं बन सकता। यदि किसी स्वीकृति से अधिकारी को कोई व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय लाभ पहुंचता है (जैसे अपने निजी भवन को विद्यालय हेतु किराए पर लेना या निर्धारित सीमा से अधिक भत्ते स्वीकृत करना), तो यह हितों का टकराव उत्पन्न करता है। अतः कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सटीक व्याख्या करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Financial propriety strictly mandates that no public authority may exercise its administrative or financial powers to sanction any expenditure that yields a direct or indirect personal benefit to itself. Eliminating conflicts of interest is essential for maintaining integrity in public administration, ensuring that every financial decision remains unbiased, objective, transparent, and driven strictly by official necessity and public benefit.

question_english: A school Principal undertakes an official journey to attend a departmental meeting. Upon return, the Principal uses their delegated financial powers as Head of Office to sanction a Daily Allowance (DA) claim for themselves at a rate exceeding the statutory entitlement, arguing that the journey was exceptionally arduous. Which principle(s) of financial propriety under GFR 2017 has been violated?
options_english: Expenditure should not be prima facie more than the occasion demands.
No authority should exercise its powers of sanctioning expenditure to its own advantage.
Both (A) and (B).
Neither (A) nor (B); the Principal has statutory discretionary power to alter allowance rates.
explanation_english:
The Principal has breached two fundamental canons of financial propriety codified in Rule 21 of GFR 2017:
1. Rule 21(ii) Violation: "The expenditure should not be prima facie more than the occasion demands." Sanctioning DA beyond the entitled limit constitutes an unjustified and inflated expense that is not warranted by statutory traveling allowance rules.
2. Rule 21(iv) Violation: "No authority should exercise its powers of sanctioning expenditure or to pass an order which will be directly or indirectly to its own advantage." A Drawing and Disbursing Officer cannot exercise delegated financial powers to grant themselves higher financial benefits or relax rules for their own enrichment. Any relaxation of TA/DA rules can only be considered by a competent superior authority (such as the Administrative Ministry/Department of Expenditure), never by the claimant officer.

1. नियम 21(ii) का उल्लंघन: "व्यय प्रथम दृष्टया अवसर की मांग से अधिक नहीं होना चाहिए।" निर्धारित हकदारी सीमा से अधिक दर पर दैनिक भत्ता स्वीकृत करना एक अनुचित और अत्यधिक व्यय है जो यात्रा भत्ता नियमों के अनुरूप नहीं है।
2. नियम 21(iv) का उल्लंघन: "किसी भी प्राधिकारी को व्यय स्वीकृत करने की अपनी शक्तियों का प्रयोग ऐसा आदेश पारित करने के लिए नहीं करना चाहिए जो प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से उसके अपने लाभ के लिए हो।" कोई भी आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) स्वयं को वित्तीय लाभ पहुंचाने या नियमों में ढील देने के लिए अपनी शक्तियों का प्रयोग नहीं कर सकता। यात्रा भत्ता नियमों में किसी भी प्रकार की छूट केवल उच्च सक्षम प्राधिकारी (प्रशासनिक मंत्रालय/व्यय विभाग) द्वारा ही दी जा सकती है, स्वयं दावेदार द्वारा नहीं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Both (A) and (B).

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Sanctioning allowance rates exceeding statutory entitlements violates two fundamental standards of financial propriety. First, public expenditure must never exceed what the occasion legitimately requires under established rules. Second, an administrative authority cannot exercise financial power to bestow monetary advantages upon itself. Deviating from prescribed travel allowance caps for personal financial benefit represents a direct breach of both core propriety principles.

question_english: Which of the following is NOT one of the general principles of financial propriety as codified under Rule 21 of GFR 2017?
options_english: The quantum of allowances granted to meet expenditure should be so regulated that they become an additional source of profit to the recipients.
Every public officer is expected to enforce financial order, strict economy, and fiscal vigilance.
Expenditure from public moneys should not be incurred for the benefit of a particular person or section of people unless specific legal or policy conditions are met.
The expenditure should not be prima facie more than what the occasion legitimately demands.
explanation_english:
Option A is NOT a principle of financial propriety; in fact, the actual rule states exactly the opposite.

Rule 21(iii) of GFR 2017 explicitly mandates:
"The amount of allowances granted to meet expenditure of a particular type should be so regulated that the allowances are not on the whole a source of profit to the recipient."

Official allowances (such as Traveling Allowance, Daily Allowance, or Conveyance Allowance) are designed purely as compensatory reimbursements for out-of-pocket expenses incurred in the performance of public duty. Under no circumstances may they be structured, claimed, or passed to generate personal savings or financial profit for government servants.
explanation_hindi:
विकल्प A वित्तीय औचित्य का सिद्धांत नहीं है; वास्तव में, वास्तविक नियम इसके बिल्कुल विपरीत प्रावधान करता है।

GFR 2017 का नियम 21(iii) स्पष्ट रूप से यह अधिदेश देता है:
"किसी विशेष प्रकार के व्यय को पूरा करने के लिए दिए जाने वाले भत्तों की राशि को इस प्रकार विनियमित किया जाना चाहिए कि वे कुल मिलाकर प्राप्तकर्ता के लिए लाभ का स्रोत न बनें।"

सरकारी भत्ते (जैसे यात्रा भत्ता, दैनिक भत्ता या वाहन भत्ता) पूरी तरह से आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों के निर्वहन में किए गए वास्तविक जेब खर्च की प्रतिपूर्ति (Compensatory Reimbursement) के रूप में दिए जाते हैं। इन्हें किसी भी परिस्थिति में सरकारी कर्मचारियों के लिए व्यक्तिगत लाभ या अतिरिक्त आय का स्रोत नहीं बनाया जा सकता।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) The amount of allowances granted to meet expenditure should be structured to become a source of profit to the recipients.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: expenditure should be structured to become a source of profit to the recipients. Standards of financial propriety stipulate that official allowances granted to public servants are strictly intended to meet legitimate expenses incurred in the discharge of public duties. Allowances must never be structured or manipulated to serve as a source of extra income or personal profit. Every spending authority must maintain financial discipline, avoid unnecessary expenditures, and ensure broad public interest orientation.

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the general principles of financial propriety under GFR 2017:

I. Expenditure should not be incurred for the benefit of a particular person or a section of the people unless a claim for the amount could be enforced in a Court of Law.
II. Expenditure for a particular person or section of the people is permissible if it is incurred in pursuance of a recognized public policy or custom.
III. Compensatory allowances may be regulated in a manner that serves as an alternative source of profit or income for employees.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
explanation_english:
Statements I and II are correct, while Statement III is incorrect.

Statutory Provisions under Rule 21(iii) of GFR 2017:
1. Expenditure for Individuals/Sections: The rule lays down that expenditure from public moneys should not be incurred for the benefit of a particular person or a section of the people, unless:
   - (a) a claim for the amount could be enforced in a Court of Law (Statement I); or
   - (b) the expenditure is in pursuance of a recognized policy or custom (Statement II).
2. Regulation of Allowances: Rule 21(iii) also provides that allowances granted to meet expenditure should be so regulated that they are "not on the whole a source of profit to the recipient". Therefore, Statement III is diametrically opposed to the rule.
explanation_hindi:
कथन I और II सही हैं, जबकि कथन III गलत है।

GFR 2017 के नियम 21(iii) के अंतर्गत वैधानिक प्रावधान:
1. विशिष्ट व्यक्तियों/वर्गों हेतु व्यय: नियम निर्धारित करता है कि सार्वजनिक धन से किसी विशेष व्यक्ति या जनसमूह के लाभ के लिए व्यय तब तक नहीं किया जाना चाहिए, जब तक कि:
   - (क) इस राशि का दावा किसी न्यायालय में कानूनी रूप से प्रवर्तित न कराया जा सके (कथन I); अथवा
   - (ख) यह व्यय किसी मान्यता प्राप्त नीति या प्रथा के अनुसरण में न हो (कथन II)।
2. भत्तों का विनियमन: नियम 21(iii) यह भी निर्देश देता है कि किसी विशेष व्यय की पूर्ति हेतु दिए जाने वाले भत्तों को इस प्रकार विनियमित किया जाए कि वे प्राप्तकर्ता के लिए "लाभ का स्रोत न बनें"। इसलिए, कथन III नियम के सर्वथा विपरीत है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Public funds must not be expended for the exclusive benefit of a private individual or a specific group unless the action fulfills a legally enforceable claim or reflects recognized policy. Additionally, official allowances are designed solely to reimburse legitimate duty expenses and must never function as profit sources for employees. Propriety rules demand strictly policy-oriented and legally backed financial allocations.

question_english: Under the financial management framework of GFR 2017, who among the following is primarily responsible for ensuring that the general principles of financial propriety and regularity are observed by all subordinate Disbursing Officers?
options_english: The Controlling Officer
The Designated Office Cashier
The Senior Store Keeper
The Principal Statutory Auditor
explanation_english:
Under GFR 2017 (Rules 10, 52, and 67), the Controlling Officer holds primary administrative and supervisory responsibility for public expenditure within their department or division.

Key Responsibilities of a Controlling Officer:
1. Ensuring Propriety and Regularity: The Controlling Officer must verify that all Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs) functioning under their supervision strictly observe the Canons of Financial Propriety, adhere to delegated financial powers, and follow accounting rules.
2. Budgetary Control: They must ensure expenditure does not exceed sanctioned grants and that allocations are utilized for the purposes intended by Parliament/Government.
3. Institutional Context: In educational directorates, the Deputy Director of Education or Regional Officer acts as the Controlling Officer overseeing school Principals (DDOs).
explanation_hindi:
GFR 2017 (नियम 10, 52 और 67) के तहत, नियंत्रक अधिकारी (Controlling Officer) अपने विभाग या प्रभाग के भीतर सार्वजनिक व्यय की प्राथमिक प्रशासनिक और पर्यवेक्षी जिम्मेदारी संभालता है।

नियंत्रक अधिकारी के मुख्य दायित्व:
1. औचित्य और नियमितता सुनिश्चित करना: नियंत्रक अधिकारी को यह सत्यापित करना होता है कि उसके पर्यवेक्षण में कार्यरत सभी आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDOs) वित्तीय औचित्य के नियमों का कड़ाई से पालन करें, प्रत्यायोजित वित्तीय शक्तियों का उल्लंघन न करें और लेखा नियमों का पालन करें।
2. बजटीय नियंत्रण: उन्हें यह सुनिश्चित करना होता है कि व्यय स्वीकृत बजट अनुदानों से अधिक न हो और धन का उपयोग उसी उद्देश्य के लिए किया जाए जिसके लिए संसद/सरकार द्वारा इसे स्वीकृत किया गया था।
3. संस्थागत संदर्भ: शिक्षा निदेशालयों में, उप शिक्षा निदेशक (DDE) या क्षेत्रीय अधिकारी नियंत्रक अधिकारी के रूप में कार्य करते हैं जो विद्यालय प्राचार्यों (DDOs) के वित्तीय कामकाज की निगरानी करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) The Controlling Officer

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Controlling Officer is primarily responsible for monitoring and supervising the financial conduct of all disbursing officers placed under their administrative jurisdiction. This responsibility includes verifying that subordinate officers strictly observe the principles of financial propriety, remain within allocated budget limits, maintain accurate accounts, submit timely financial returns, and prevent any unauthorized, wasteful, or illegal expenditure of public funds.

question_english: Under GFR 2017, what is the statutory consequence if a public officer fails to observe the standards of financial propriety, resulting in a pecuniary loss of public funds to the Government?
options_english: The loss is immediately written off from the official accounts without any administrative inquiry
The financial liability is absorbed entirely by the internal audit wing of the Ministry of Finance
The monetary loss is automatically debited against the next financial year's capital budget allocation
The officer may be held personally responsible and legally liable to make good the financial loss
explanation_english:
Under Rules 22, 33, and 34 of GFR 2017, every public officer is personally responsible for any loss sustained by the Government through fraud, negligence, or breach of financial rules and propriety.

Key Statutory Mechanisms:
1. Personal Accountability: When negligence or failure to observe financial propriety causes loss of public money, the responsible officer is subject to disciplinary action under the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965.
2. Recovery of Loss: The Government is empowered to enforce recovery of the entire loss or part thereof from the pay, allowances, or pensionary benefits of the delinquent official.
3. Write-off Safeguards: A loss cannot be written off casually; write-off procedures under Rule 33 are strictly invoked only after exhaustive inquiries determine that the loss cannot be recovered from the responsible person.
explanation_hindi:
GFR 2017 के नियम 22, 33 और 34 के अंतर्गत, प्रत्येक सरकारी अधिकारी धोखाधड़ी, लापरवाही या वित्तीय नियमों और औचित्य के उल्लंघन के कारण सरकार को होने वाली किसी भी हानि के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से उत्तरदायी है।

प्रमुख वैधानिक तंत्र:
1. व्यक्तिगत जवाबदेही: जब लापरवाही या वित्तीय औचित्य के उल्लंघन से सार्वजनिक धन की हानि होती है, तो संबंधित अधिकारी सीसीएस (सीसीए) नियम, 1965 के तहत अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई का भागीदार बनता है।
2. हानि की वसूली: सरकार को दोषी अधिकारी के वेतन, भत्तों या सेवानिवृत्ति परिलाभों से संपूर्ण हानि या उसके एक भाग की वसूली करने का वैधानिक अधिकार प्राप्त है।
3. बट्टे खाते में डालने (Write-off) संबंधी नियम: नियम 33 के तहत किसी हानि को आसानी से माफ नहीं किया जा सकता; यह प्रक्रिया केवल तभी अपनाई जाती है जब गहन जांच के बाद यह सिद्ध हो जाए कि जिम्मेदार व्यक्ति से वसूली संभव नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The officer may be held personally responsible and liable to make good the loss.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: and liable to make good the loss. When a public officer neglects standards of financial propriety or breaches established procedure, leading to a loss of public funds, administrative accountability is directly assigned. The responsible official can be subjected to disciplinary proceedings and held personally liable to make good the financial loss. Writing off losses occurs only after exhaustive efforts fail to recover funds from delinquent employees.

question_english: Which of the following actions represents a direct violation of the canon of financial propriety requiring that "expenditure should not be prima facie more than the occasion demands"?
options_english: Procuring standardized laboratory equipment for secondary classes at GeM-approved rates
Booking a banquet hall in a luxury five-star hotel using government school funds to conduct a routine staff meeting
Paying the standard government electricity tariffs for the school building
Purchasing necessary first-aid and medical supplies for the school infirmary
explanation_english:
Booking an expensive five-star hotel for a routine staff meeting represents a blatant breach of Rule 21(ii) of GFR 2017, which mandates that "The expenditure should not be prima facie more than the occasion demands."

Analysis:
1. Extravagance vs Economy: A routine administrative meeting requires a standard, modest meeting room. Hosting it in a luxury commercial hotel using public educational funds is grossly disproportionate to the administrative occasion, especially when school halls or departmental premises are available at no extra cost.
2. Legitimate Expenditures: Purchasing lab equipment, paying utility bills, and stocking first-aid supplies are essential, cost-controlled, and proportionate expenditures that satisfy the standards of financial propriety.
explanation_hindi:
एक नियमित स्टाफ बैठक के लिए एक महंगे पांच सितारा होटल को बुक करना GFR 2017 के नियम 21(ii) का खुला उल्लंघन है, जो यह निर्धारित करता है कि "व्यय प्रथम दृष्टया अवसर की मांग से अधिक नहीं होना चाहिए।"

विश्लेषण:
1. अपव्यय बनाम मितव्ययिता: एक सामान्य प्रशासनिक बैठक के लिए एक साधारण बैठक कक्ष पर्याप्त होता है। सरकारी विद्यालय कोष से लग्जरी होटल में ऐसी बैठक आयोजित करना अवसर की तुलना में अत्यधिक और असंगत व्यय है, विशेषकर जब विद्यालय सभागार बिना किसी अतिरिक्त लागत के उपलब्ध हो।
2. वैध व्यय: प्रयोगशाला उपकरण खरीदना, उपयोगिता बिलों का भुगतान करना और प्राथमिक उपचार सामग्री रखना आवश्यक, लागत-नियंत्रित और आनुपातिक व्यय हैं जो वित्तीय औचित्य की कसौटी पर खरे उतरते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Organizing a routine staff meeting in a five- star hotel using school funds.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: star hotel using school funds. Hosting a routine departmental staff meeting in an expensive luxury venue represents an extravagant expenditure that clearly exceeds what the occasion reasonably demands. Standards of financial propriety require maintaining strict economy and choosing cost-effective options for public business. Unnecessary lavish spending of public funds on basic routine administrative functions constitutes a direct violation of fundamental financial propriety principles.

question_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 का कौन-सा नियम "सार्वजनिक खरीद के मौलिक सिद्धांत" (Fundamental principles of public buying) को परिभाषित करता है?
options_hindi: नियम 21
नियम 130
नियम 144
नियम 170
source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017

question_english: Which rule in the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 defines the "Fundamental principles of public buying"?
options_english: Rule 21
Rule 130
Rule 144
Rule 170
explanation_english:
Rule 144 of Chapter 6 of GFR 2017 explicitly defines the "Fundamental principles of public buying".

Scope of Rule 144:
1. Core Yardsticks: It establishes the yardsticks governing every public procurement, requiring procuring authorities to bring efficiency, economy, and transparency, ensure fair and equitable treatment of suppliers, and promote open competition.
2. Distinct from other rules:
   - Rule 21: Standards of Financial Propriety.
   - Rule 130: Execution of original works and repair works.
   - Rule 144: Fundamental principles of public buying (Procurement of Goods).
   - Rule 170: Bid Security (Earnest Money Deposit - EMD).
explanation_hindi:
GFR 2017 के अध्याय 6 का नियम 144 स्पष्ट रूप से "सार्वजनिक खरीद के मौलिक सिद्धांत" (Fundamental principles of public buying) को परिभाषित करता है।

नियम 144 का दायरा:
1. मुख्य मानक: यह प्रत्येक सार्वजनिक खरीद को नियंत्रित करने वाले मानकों को स्थापित करता है, जिसके तहत खरीद प्राधिकारियों को दक्षता, मितव्ययिता और पारदर्शिता सुनिश्चित करनी होती है, आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के साथ निष्पक्ष व्यवहार करना होता है और खुली प्रतिस्पर्धा को बढ़ावा देना होता है।
2. अन्य नियमों से भिन्नता:
   - नियम 21: वित्तीय औचित्य के मानक।
   - नियम 130: मूल निर्माण कार्यों और मरम्मत कार्यों का निष्पादन।
   - नियम 144: सार्वजनिक खरीद के मौलिक सिद्धांत (वस्तुओं की खरीद)।
   - नियम 170: बोली सुरक्षा (बयाना राशि - EMD)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Rule 144

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Rule 144 of the General Financial Rules 2017 establishes the fundamental principles governing public buying and procurement of goods. This rule outlines essential yardsticks that every procuring authority must follow, mandating efficiency, economy, fairness, equal treatment of suppliers, transparency, and accountability in all procurement operations to ensure that public money achieves optimum value without administrative bias or procedural delays.

question_english: The fundamental principles of public buying under GFR 2017 mandate that every authority delegated with the financial powers of procuring goods in public interest shall have the responsibility and accountability to bring:
options_english: Profitability, flexibility, and speed
Centralization, standardization, and monopoly
Discretion, ambiguity, and bilateral negotiation
Efficiency, economy, and transparency
explanation_english:
Under Rule 144 of GFR 2017, the opening mandate specifies:
"Every authority delegated with the financial powers of procuring goods in public interest shall have the responsibility and accountability to bring: (a) Efficiency, economy, and transparency; (b) Fair and equitable treatment of suppliers; and (c) Promotion of competition in public procurement."

Significance for School Principals:
When procuring classroom furniture, lab supplies, or smart boards, a Principal must:
1. Efficiency: Conduct procurement in a timely and organized manner without procedural delays.
2. Economy: Procure goods at the most competitive, reasonable market price.
3. Transparency: Maintain open specifications, objective criteria, and documented purchase files (preferably through GeM).
explanation_hindi:
GFR 2017 के नियम 144 के तहत आरंभिक अधिदेश स्पष्ट रूप से निर्धारित करता है:
"सार्वजनिक हित में वस्तुओं की खरीद के लिए वित्तीय शक्तियों से संपन्न प्रत्येक प्राधिकारी की यह जिम्मेदारी और जवाबदेही होगी कि वह: (क) दक्षता, मितव्ययिता और पारदर्शिता; (ख) आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के साथ निष्पक्ष और न्यायसंगत व्यवहार; तथा (ग) सार्वजनिक खरीद में प्रतिस्पर्धा को बढ़ावा देना सुनिश्चित करे।"

विद्यालय प्राचार्यों के लिए महत्व:
कक्षा फर्नीचर, प्रयोगशाला आपूर्ति या स्मार्ट बोर्ड खरीदते समय प्राचार्य को निम्नलिखित सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए:
1. दक्षता (Efficiency): बिना प्रक्रियात्मक देरी के समयबद्ध खरीद करना।
2. मितव्ययिता (Economy): सबसे प्रतिस्पर्धी और उचित बाजार मूल्य पर सामान प्राप्त करना।
3. पारदर्शिता (Transparency): स्पष्ट विनिर्देश, वस्तुनिष्ठ मूल्यांकन मानदंड और पूर्ण दस्तावेज बनाए रखना (विशेषकर GeM के माध्यम से)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Efficiency, economy, and transparency

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Public procurement mandates that authorities exercising delegated financial powers bring efficiency, economy, and transparency to every transaction. Procuring officers are accountable for obtaining quality goods at competitive market rates while maintaining open, non- discriminatory procedures. Achieving optimal value for public money requires balancing swift administrative execution with robust anti- corruption mechanisms, equal opportunity for vendors, and thorough public documentation of choices.

question_hindi: एक विद्यालय प्रमुख को एक नई आईटी प्रयोगशाला स्थापित करने के लिए तत्काल 50 कंप्यूटर सेट खरीदने की आवश्यकता है। उच्च प्राधिकारी से प्रशासनिक स्वीकृति लेने से बचने और औपचारिक प्रतिस्पर्धी निविदा प्रक्रिया को दरकिनार करने के लिए, विद्यालय प्रमुख दो सप्ताह की अवधि में 10-10 कंप्यूटरों के पांच अलग-अलग खरीद आदेशों में इस खरीद को विभाजित कर देते हैं। GFR 2017 के अनुसार, यह प्रशासनिक कार्रवाई:
options_hindi: प्रतिबंधित है, क्योंकि उच्च प्राधिकारी की स्वीकृति अथवा प्रतिस्पर्धी बोली से बचने के लिए मांग को विभाजित करना कड़ाई से प्रतिबंधित है।
विद्यार्थियों के डिजिटल अधिगम में तेजी लाने हेतु आपातकालीन प्रशासनिक शक्तियों के तहत अनुमेय है।
विद्यालय खातों में परिचालन तरलता बनाए रखने के लिए वित्तीय दिशानिर्देशों द्वारा अनुशंसित है।

question_english: A Head of School urgently needs to purchase 50 computer sets for establishing a new IT lab. To avoid obtaining administrative approval from the higher authority and to bypass the formal competitive tendering process, the Head splits the purchase into five separate orders of 10 computers each over a span of two weeks. Under GFR 2017, this administrative action is:
options_english: Prohibited, as splitting demand to avoid obtaining the sanction of a higher authority or competitive bidding is strictly restricted.
Permissible under administrative emergency powers to expedite student digital learning.
Recommended by financial guidelines to maintain operational liquidity in school accounts.
Permissible provided the total expenditure is subsequently ratified by the School Management Committee (SMC).
explanation_english:
Splitting of procurement requirements is strictly illegal under the General Financial Rules.

Statutory Rule:
Rule 157 of GFR 2017 states: "A demand for goods should not be divided into smaller quantities for making piecemeal purchases for the purpose of avoiding the necessity of obtaining the sanction of higher authority required with reference to the estimated value of the total demand."

Consequences and Implications:
1. Demand aggregation: Public buying principles mandate assessing and aggregating the full foreseeable requirement over a reasonable period (such as an academic session or financial year).
2. Violation: Artificially breaking up a bulk purchase into small batches (piecemeal purchasing) to fit within petty purchase limits (Rule 154 or Rule 155) or to bypass GeM bidding thresholds is a serious financial irregularity inviting disciplinary action against the DDO.
explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों के तहत खरीद आवश्यकताओं को कृत्रिम रूप से विभाजित करना पूरी तरह से अवैध है।

वैधानिक नियम:
GFR 2017 का नियम 157 स्पष्ट रूप से कहता है: "कुल मांग के अनुमानित मूल्य के संदर्भ में आवश्यक उच्च प्राधिकारी की स्वीकृति प्राप्त करने की आवश्यकता से बचने के उद्देश्य से वस्तुओं की मांग को टुकड़ों में खरीद करने के लिए छोटी मात्रा में विभाजित नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।"

परिणाम और निहितार्थ:
1. मांग का समूहन (Demand Aggregation): सार्वजनिक खरीद नियमों के अनुसार एक उचित अवधि (जैसे एक शैक्षणिक सत्र या वित्तीय वर्ष) के लिए संपूर्ण आवश्यकता का आकलन और समूहन किया जाना चाहिए।
2. उल्लंघन: एकमुश्त खरीद को छोटी-छोटी श्रेणियों में विभाजित करना ताकि वे नियम 154 या 155 (बिना निविदा खरीद) की सीमाओं में आ सकें या GeM बोली से बचा जा सके, एक गंभीर वित्तीय अनियमितता है जिसके लिए DDO अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई का भागीदार बनता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Prohibited, as splitting demand to avoid obtaining sanction of higher authority is restricted.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: obtaining sanction of higher authority is restricted. Dividing a single total requirement into multiple smaller purchase orders to circumvent the monetary limits requiring higher administrative approval or formal competitive tendering is strictly prohibited under financial rules. Demand splitting undermines centralized procurement oversight and violates transparency principles. Procuring authorities must consolidate requirements over a reasonable timeframe to ensure open competitive pricing and appropriate administrative approval levels.

question_hindi:
GFR 2017 के नियम 144 (सार्वजनिक खरीद के मौलिक सिद्धांत) के तहत निर्धारित निम्नलिखित मानदंडों पर विचार कीजिए:

I. गुणवत्ता और प्रकार के संदर्भ में विनिर्देश संगठन की बुनियादी आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने वाले होने चाहिए और उनमें अनावश्यक सुविधाएं शामिल नहीं होनी चाहिए।
II. इन्वेंटरी लॉक-अप को रोकने के लिए वास्तविक आवश्यकता से अधिक मात्रा में खरीद से बचने की सावधानी बरती जानी चाहिए।
III. एक निष्पक्ष, पारदर्शी और उचित प्रक्रिया का पालन करते हुए प्रस्ताव आमंत्रित किए जाने चाहिए।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?

question_english:
Consider the following yardsticks laid down under Rule 144 of GFR 2017 (Fundamental principles of public buying):

I. The specifications in terms of quality and type should meet the basic needs of the organization without including superfluous features.
II. Care should be taken to avoid purchasing quantities in excess of genuine requirement to prevent inventory lock-up.
III. Offers should be invited following a fair, transparent, and reasonable procedure.
IV. Technical specifications should be drawn up in a restrictive manner to limit the bidding exclusively to a preferred single brand.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and III only
II, III and IV only
I, III and IV only
I, II, III and IV
explanation_english:
Statements I, II, and III are correct, whereas Statement IV directly violates Rule 144.

Statutory Mandate under Rule 144 of GFR 2017:
1. Objective Specifications (Rule 144(i)(a)): The description of the subject matter of procurement must be objective, functional, and meet the basic needs of the organization without incorporating superfluous or luxury features.
2. Prohibition of Brand Bias (Rule 144(i)(b)): Technical specifications shall NOT indicate a requirement for a particular trademark, trade name, patent, design, origin, or specific producer unless there is no other sufficiently precise way of describing the requirements (and even then, words like "or equivalent" must be included). Tailoring specifications to favor a single vendor/brand is prohibited.
3. Quantity Control (Rule 144(ii)): Over-purchasing leads to wastage and inventory holding costs.
4. Transparency (Rule 144(iii)): Procurement must be conducted through an open, transparent, and non-discriminatory competitive process.
explanation_hindi:
कथन I, II और III सही हैं, जबकि कथन IV नियम 144 का सीधा उल्लंघन करता है।

GFR 2017 के नियम 144 के तहत वैधानिक अधिदेश:
1. वस्तुनिष्ठ विनिर्देश (नियम 144(i)(a)): खरीद की विषय-वस्तु का विवरण वस्तुनिष्ठ और कार्यात्मक होना चाहिए, जो बिना किसी अनावश्यक या विलासितापूर्ण विशेषताओं के संगठन की बुनियादी जरूरतों को पूरा करे।
2. ब्रांड पक्षपात का निषेध (नियम 144(i)(b)): तकनीकी विनिर्देशों में किसी विशेष ट्रेडमार्क, ब्रांड नाम, पेटेंट, डिजाइन या विशिष्ट निर्माता का उल्लेख नहीं होना चाहिए, जिससे प्रतिस्पर्धा प्रतिबंधित होती हो। किसी एक विक्रेता/ब्रांड को लाभ पहुंचाने के लिए विनिर्देश तैयार करना पूरी तरह प्रतिबंधित है।
3. मात्रा नियंत्रण (नियम 144(ii)): वास्तविक आवश्यकता से अधिक खरीद करने से बर्बादी और पूंजी अवरुद्ध होती है।
4. पारदर्शिता (नियम 144(iii)): खरीद प्रक्रिया खुली, पारदर्शी और गैर-भेदभावपूर्ण प्रतिस्पर्धी प्रणाली के माध्यम से आयोजित की जानी चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Public procurement yardsticks mandate that technical specifications meet actual organizational requirements without including unnecessary, restrictive, or luxurious features. Procuring authorities must avoid purchasing quantities exceeding actual needs and must invite offers through transparent, competitive procedures. Drawing up specifications to favor or restrict bidding to a single brand is strictly prohibited, as procurement must remain open and non-discriminatory.

अभिकथन (A): खरीद प्राधिकारी को सार्वजनिक खरीद प्रक्रिया के दौरान सभी पात्र आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के साथ निष्पक्ष, खुला और समान व्यवहार सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए।
कारण (R): सार्वजनिक खरीद में सार्वजनिक धन का सर्वोत्तम मूल्य (Value for Money) प्राप्त करने के लिए पारदर्शिता और वास्तविक प्रतिस्पर्धा अपरिहार्य हैं।

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The procuring authority must ensure fair, open, and equitable treatment of all eligible suppliers during the public procurement process.
Reason (R): Transparency and genuine competition are indispensable to achieve the best value for money in public procurement.

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
explanation_english:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

1. Mandate under GFR Rule 144: Rule 144 of GFR 2017 establishes that procuring authorities must afford equal and non-discriminatory opportunity to all eligible bidders.
2. Economic Rationale: When government procurement is fair and transparent, more vendors participate without fear of bias or favoritism. Robust competition drives down commercial prices, enhances product quality, eliminates cartels, and ensures that the public exchequer attains the optimal "value for money". Hence, Reason (R) provides the foundational economic and policy rationale that explains why Assertion (A) is mandated.
explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या प्रस्तुत करता है।

1. GFR नियम 144 के तहत अधिदेश: GFR 2017 का नियम 144 यह स्थापित करता है कि खरीद प्राधिकारियों को सभी पात्र बोलीदाताओं को समान और गैर-भेदभावपूर्ण अवसर प्रदान करना चाहिए।
2. आर्थिक औचित्य: जब सरकारी खरीद निष्पक्ष और पारदर्शी होती है, तो आपूर्तिकर्ता बिना किसी पक्षपात के डर के बोली प्रक्रिया में भाग लेते हैं। मजबूत और स्वस्थ प्रतिस्पर्धा से कीमतें कम होती हैं, उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता में सुधार होता है और सरकार को सार्वजनिक धन का सर्वोत्तम मूल्य (Value for Money) प्राप्त होता है। इसलिए, कारण (R) यह सटीक तार्किक व्याख्या प्रदान करता है कि अभिकथन (A) क्यों अनिवार्य किया गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Procuring authorities are required to offer fair and equitable treatment to all prospective suppliers throughout the public procurement process. Encouraging open competition and maintaining full transparency in bidding procedures prevents favoritism and allows the government to secure the best technical quality at the most economical market price, thereby achieving optimal value for expenditure of public money.
