question_english: During the physical verification of an IT laboratory, the verification committee discovers that two desktop monitors are missing. What is the immediate procedural requirement under GFR 2017 regarding this finding?
options_english: The missing monitors are automatically struck off from the register without any formal administrative procedure.
The members of the physical verification committee must personally reimburse the purchase cost of the missing monitors.
The school administration must silently purchase replacement monitors using local school funds to cover up the shortage.
The discrepancy must be formally recorded and the Head of Office must initiate an inquiry to fix responsibility.
explanation_english: As per Rule 213 and Rule 214 of General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, along with Rule 33 and Rule 34 concerning reports of losses, any shortage, loss, or discrepancy discovered during the physical verification of fixed assets or stores must be immediately recorded in the physical verification report and brought to the notice of the Head of Office (HOO) / competent authority. The Head of Office (e.g., School Principal) is duty-bound to initiate an immediate administrative inquiry to ascertain the cause of the loss (whether due to theft, fraud, or negligence), fix responsibility on the defaulting custodian/custody officer, and process the matter either for recovery or formal write-off under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR). Striking off assets arbitrarily or covering shortages by unapproved purchases is illegal under financial regulations.
explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 213 और 214 के साथ पठित नियम 33 एवं 34 (हानियों की रिपोर्ट) के अनुसार, अचल परिसंपत्तियों या भंडार के भौतिक सत्यापन के दौरान पाई गई किसी भी प्रकार की कमी, क्षति या विसंगति को भौतिक सत्यापन रिपोर्ट में विधिवत दर्ज किया जाना अनिवार्य है। कार्यालयाध्यक्ष (जैसे विद्यालय के प्राचार्य) का यह विधिक दायित्व है कि वे इस विसंगति को संज्ञान में लेकर तुरंत एक प्रशासनिक जांच शुरू करें, ताकि हानि के वास्तविक कारणों (चोरी, कपट या घोर उपेक्षा) का पता लगाया जा सके, संबंधित स्टॉक अभिरक्षक पर उत्तरदायित्व निर्धारित किया जा सके, तथा वित्तीय अधिकार प्रत्यायोजन नियमों (DFPR) के तहत वसूली या अपलेखन (write-off) की प्रक्रिया प्रारंभ की जा सके। किसी भी सरकारी सामग्री को बिना जांच के रजिस्टर से हटाना या गुप्त रूप से प्रतिस्थापन करना वित्तीय नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The discrepancy must be recorded and the Head of Office must initiate an inquiry to fix responsibility.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Head of Office must initiate an inquiry to fix responsibility. When physical verification reveals missing non-consumable assets, the verification committee must document the discrepancy in the verification report. The Head of Office is required to initiate an immediate administrative inquiry to investigate the cause of the loss, fix responsibility for negligence, and initiate formal recovery or write-off procedures under financial rules.

question_hindi: भौतिक सत्यापन (Physical Verification) पूरा करने के बाद, सत्यापन अधिकारी को सत्यापन का प्रमाण पत्र (Certificate of Verification) कहाँ दर्ज करना चाहिए?
options_hindi: संबंधित स्टॉक रजिस्टर में अपने दिनांकित हस्ताक्षर के साथ।
एक सादे सरकारी पत्र पर जिसे सीधे वित्त मंत्रालय के व्यय विभाग को प्रेषित किया जाए।
सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन के लिए अमिट स्याही वाले मार्कर पेन का उपयोग करके सीधे परिसंपत्ति की सतह पर।
प्राचार्य की वार्षिक कार्य निष्पादन मूल्यांकन रिपोर्ट (APAR) की गोपनीय टिप्पणियों में।

question_english: After completing the physical verification of stores or fixed assets, where must the verifying officer record the certificate of verification as per GFR rules?
options_english: In the relevant stock register under their dated signature.
On a plain official sheet forwarded directly to the Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance.
Directly on the physical surface of the asset using an indelible permanent marker pen for public display.
As confidential notes recorded exclusively in the Principal's annual performance appraisal dossier.
explanation_english: Under GFR 2017 Rule 213(2) (Fixed Assets) and Rule 214/215 (Consumable Goods and Materials), a certificate of verification stating the exact results and findings of the physical verification must be recorded directly in the relevant Stock Register or Fixed Asset Register under the dated signature of the inspecting officer or verification committee. This entry provides statutory audit proof that the physical verification was duly executed, discrepancies (if any) were officially noted on the ledger, and the balances shown in the stock ledger match ground reality at that specific point in time.
explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 213(2) (अचल परिसंपत्तियों) तथा नियम 214/215 (उपभोज्य एवं अन्य सामग्री) के अंतर्गत यह अनिवार्य है कि भौतिक सत्यापन पूर्ण होने पर सत्यापन अधिकारी या समिति द्वारा सत्यापन का परिणाम दर्शाते हुए एक औपचारिक प्रमाण पत्र संबंधित स्टॉक रजिस्टर या अचल परिसंपत्ति रजिस्टर में ही अपने दिनांकित हस्ताक्षर सहित दर्ज किया जाए। यह प्रविष्टि वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा (Audit) के लिए यह पुख्ता प्रमाण प्रस्तुत करती है कि भौतिक सत्यापन वास्तविक रूप से संपन्न हुआ, शेष स्टॉक का मिलान किया गया तथा यदि कोई विसंगति थी तो उसे स्टॉक बही में विधिवत दर्ज किया गया।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) In the relevant stock register under their dated signature.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: dated signature. Upon completing physical verification of stores or fixed assets, the verifying officer or committee must record a formal verification certificate directly in the relevant stock register. The certificate must state the findings, note any discrepancies found, and be authenticated by the dated signature of the inspecting officer to maintain official audit records.

question_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 217 के अंतर्गत, जब कोई वस्तु सामान्य टूट-फूट या अप्रचलन (Obsolescence) के कारण उपयोग के अयोग्य हो जाती है, तो उसे आधिकारिक तौर पर उपयोग के अनुपयुक्त घोषित करने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?

कंडमनेशन / अनुपयोगी घोषित करना (Condemnation)

question_english: Under Rule 217 of GFR 2017, when an item becomes unserviceable due to normal wear and tear or technical obsolescence, what is the formal administrative process of declaring it unfit for use called?
options_english: Depreciation
Condemnation
Sequestration
Write-off
explanation_english: Under Chapter 7 (Disposal of Goods), Rule 217 of GFR 2017, an item may be declared surplus, obsolete, or unserviceable if the same is of no further use to the department. The formal administrative inspection and declaration of an item as unfit for continued service due to fair wear and tear or technical obsolescence is termed 'Condemnation'. Condemnation by a competent authority or Condemnation Committee is a mandatory prerequisite before any government property can be legally written off from stock records and sold, scrapped, or disposed of.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के अध्याय 7 (वस्तुओं का निपटान) के नियम 217 के अंतर्गत, जब कोई वस्तु सामान्य टूट-फूट, क्षति या तकनीकी अप्रचलन के कारण विभाग के लिए उपयोगी नहीं रह जाती है, तो उसे अनुपयोगी, अधिशेष या अप्रचलित घोषित करने की औपचारिक प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया 'कंडमनेशन' (Condemnation / अनुपयोगी घोषित करना) कहलाती है। कंडमनेशन समिति की संस्तुति और सक्षम प्राधिकारी के अनुमोदन के बाद ही किसी सरकारी सामग्री को स्टॉक रजिस्टर से अपलेखित (write-off) करने और सार्वजनिक निपटान/नीलामी की प्रक्रिया शुरू की जा सकती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Condemnation

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Rule 217 of the General Financial Rules 2017, condemnation is the formal administrative process of inspecting and declaring an asset unserviceable due to normal operational wear and tear, physical damage, or technical obsolescence. Declaring an item condemned is a mandatory prerequisite before striking it off registers and initiating disposal.

question_hindi: भंडार/सामग्री के कंडमनेशन (अनुपयोगी घोषित करने) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से सही कथन की पहचान कीजिए।
options_hindi: स्टॉक अभिरक्षा रखने वाला कोई भी अराजपत्रित समूह 'ग' (Group C) कर्मचारी स्वतंत्र रूप से कार्यालय की वस्तुओं को कंडम घोषित कर सकता है।

सरकारी परिसंपत्तियों के कंडमनेशन की प्रक्रिया बिना किसी भौतिक निरीक्षण के पूरी तरह से कागजी स्तर पर की जा सकती है।

question_english: Identify the correct statement regarding the condemnation of stores and government assets under GFR 2017.
options_english: Any non-gazetted Group C employee holding stock custody can independently declare office items as condemned.
An item may be declared surplus, obsolete, or unserviceable on the recommendation of a duly constituted Condemnation Committee.
Condemnation of government assets can be processed entirely on paper without conducting any physical inspection.
Condemned items must be permanently stored in a dead stock room and must never be disposed of through public sale.
explanation_english: According to Rule 217 and Rule 218 of GFR 2017, government stores cannot be arbitrarily declared condemned by individual storekeepers or stock custodians. The competent authority must constitute a Survey Committee / Condemnation Committee comprising competent officers (and technical experts where technical equipment is involved). This committee conducts a thorough physical inspection of the assets, evaluates repairability versus economic viability, and submits a formal condemnation report. Only upon the committee's formal recommendation and subsequent sanction by the competent authority under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR) can goods be declared surplus, obsolete, or unserviceable for disposal.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 217 एवं 218 के अनुसार, किसी भी सरकारी भंडार या परिसंपत्ति को व्यक्तिगत स्टोरकीपर या लिपिक द्वारा मनमाने ढंग से अनुपयोगी घोषित नहीं किया जा सकता। सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा विधिवत गठित 'कंडमनेशन समिति' (Condemnation Committee / सर्वेक्षण समिति) द्वारा परिसंपत्तियों का भौतिक निरीक्षण किया जाता है। समिति उनकी उपयोगिता, मरम्मत की आर्थिक सार्थकता तथा तकनीकी अप्रचलन का मूल्यांकन करके अपनी औपचारिक संस्तुति प्रस्तुत करती है। सक्षम प्राधिकारी की वित्तीय स्वीकृति के उपरांत ही उन वस्तुओं को अधिशेष, अप्रचलित या अनुपयोगी घोषित कर निपटान की कार्रवाई की जाती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) An item may be declared surplus, obsolete, or unserviceable on recommendation of a Condemnation Committee.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: or unserviceable on recommendation of a Condemnation Committee. Condemnation of public property requires formal evaluation by a duly constituted Condemnation Committee or Board. The committee physically inspects the assets and submits formal recommendations regarding unserviceability, technical obsolescence, or surplus status. Individual storekeepers or Group C employees cannot independently declare assets condemned without proper committee inspection and competent authority sanction.

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the disposal of condemned goods under GFR 2017:
I. Condemned items can be disposed of by inviting bids through advertised tender or public auction.
II. E-waste must be disposed of in strict accordance with the statutory guidelines issued by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC).
III. If the residual value is very low, the goods may be disposed of through a local scrap dealer following a transparent competitive process.
IV. Condemned goods may be gifted to the personal friends or acquaintances of the Head of Office.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and III
I, III and IV
II, III and IV
I, II, III and IV
explanation_english: Rule 218 of GFR 2017 outlines the modes of disposal of surplus, obsolete, or unserviceable goods: (i) Advertised tender or public auction (Rule 218(1)(i)); (ii) Inviting quotations from scrap dealers when the assessed residual value is negligible or below prescribed limits (Rule 218(1)(ii)); and (iii) Hazardous and electronic waste must be disposed of strictly in compliance with statutory rules such as the E-Waste (Management) Rules issued by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) through authorized dismantlers/recyclers. Public property cannot be gifted or transferred to personal friends or relatives of government officers under any circumstances (Statement IV is completely illegal and false). Thus, Statements I, II, and III are correct.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 218 के तहत कंडम या अनुपयोगी वस्तुओं के निपटान के स्पष्ट नियम दिए गए हैं: (i) विज्ञापित निविदा या सार्वजनिक नीलामी द्वारा निपटान (नियम 218(1)(i)); (ii) जब अवशिष्ट मूल्य अत्यंत कम हो, तो प्रतिस्पर्धी कोटेशन प्राप्त करके स्थानीय कबाड़ी/स्क्रैप डीलर को पारदर्शी तरीके से बेचना (नियम 218(1)(ii)); तथा (iii) ई-कचरे और बैटरियों का निपटान पर्यावरण, वन एवं जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय द्वारा अधिसूचित ई-अपशिष्ट (प्रबंधन) नियमों के अनुसार केवल अधिकृत पुनर्चक्रणकर्ताओं (authorized recyclers) के माध्यम से किया जाना अनिवार्य है। किसी भी सरकारी सामग्री को अधिकारियों के मित्रों या परिचितों को उपहार में देना गैर-कानूनी और वित्तीय कदाचार है (कथन IV असत्य है)। अतः कथन I, II और III सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Condemned goods must be disposed of transparently through public auctions, advertised tenders, or direct sales to scrap dealers when residual value is minimal. Disposal of electronic waste must strictly comply with statutory environmental e-waste management regulations. Gifting public property to acquaintances or personal friends of administrative officers is strictly illegal and prohibited.

question_english: A government school possesses 50 broken dual desks that are beyond repair and have been formally condemned by the committee. The assessed scrap value is approximately Rs. 4,000. What is the most practical and rule-compliant method for the Principal to dispose of them under GFR?
options_english: Organize an open advertised national e-auction through central government portals regardless of administrative cost.
Incinerate the broken wooden desks inside the school playground premises to clear storage space immediately.
Sell them to a local scrap vendor by obtaining limited local quotations since the assessed scrap value is minimal.
Distribute the condemned desks free of cost among interested teaching and non-teaching school staff members.
explanation_english: Under Rule 218(1)(ii) of GFR 2017, when the assessed residual or scrap value of unserviceable goods is very low (e.g., up to Rs. 2 Lakhs, and particularly in minor amounts like Rs. 4,000), floating open advertised tenders or national e-auctions would incur administrative and advertising costs far exceeding the residual value of the items. The rules therefore permit disposal by inviting limited quotations from local scrap dealers through a transparent, competitive process to realize fair market scrap value. Burning government property creates environmental and fire hazards and is strictly prohibited, while free distribution among staff violates public property stewardship.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 218(1)(ii) के अनुसार, जब अनुपयोगी वस्तुओं का आकलित अवशिष्ट या कबाड़ मूल्य अत्यंत कम (जैसे ₹4,000) होता है, तो राष्ट्रीय स्तर की विज्ञापित निविदा या ई-नीलामी आयोजित करने पर होने वाला प्रशासनिक व्यय प्राप्त होने वाले राजस्व से कहीं अधिक हो जाएगा। अतः वित्तीय नियम ऐसी अल्प-मूल्य वाली वस्तुओं के त्वरित एवं किफायती निपटान हेतु स्थानीय कबाड़ विक्रेताओं से सीमित कोटेशन (limited quotations) आमंत्रित कर पारदर्शी तरीके से बेचने की अनुमति देते हैं। स्कूल परिसर में लकड़ी जलाना पर्यावरण एवं सुरक्षा नियमों के विरुद्ध है तथा स्टाफ में मुफ्त बांटना सरकारी संपत्ति के नियमों का उल्लंघन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Sell them to a local scrap vendor by obtaining limited local quotations since value is small.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: limited local quotations since value is small. When the assessed scrap value of condemned property is minimal, organizing national e-auctions or open advertised tenders incurs disproportionate administrative expense. Financial rules permit disposing of low-value scrap by inviting limited quotations from local scrap dealers, ensuring an economical, expedient, and transparent disposal process that recovers monetary residual value for the government. question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Disposal of obsolete computers, electronic hardware, and used batteries must be executed exclusively through authorized dismantlers and recyclers.
Reason (R): Electronic waste contains toxic and hazardous substances, and its disposal is strictly governed by statutory E-Waste (Management) Rules acknowledged under GFR provisions.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
explanation_english: Under GFR 2017 Rule 218 and MoEFCC guidelines, electronic items (computers, printers, monitors) and chemical batteries cannot be sold as ordinary scrap to unauthorized local ragpickers or scrap dealers. Electronic waste contains hazardous elements like lead, mercury, cadmium, and brominated flame retardants. Therefore, the statutory E-Waste (Management) Rules and Battery Waste Management Rules legally obligate all government departments and institutions to dispose of e-waste only through Central/State Pollution Control Board (CPCB/SPCB) registered and authorized dismantlers or recyclers. Thus, Assertion (A) is true, Reason (R) is true, and (R) correctly explains why such disposal is strictly restricted.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 218 तथा पर्यावरण, वन एवं जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय (MoEFCC) के दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार, अनुपयोगी कंप्यूटर, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण और बैटरियों को सामान्य कबाड़ की तरह खुले बाजार में नहीं बेचा जा सकता। ई-कचरे में सीसा (lead), पारा (mercury) और कैडमियम जैसे खतरनाक और विषाक्त भारी धातु होते हैं जो पर्यावरण और मानव स्वास्थ्य को गंभीर नुकसान पहुंचाते हैं। अतः वैधानिक 'ई-अपशिष्ट (प्रबंधन) नियम' यह अनिवार्य करते हैं कि सरकारी कार्यालय केवल केंद्रीय/राज्य प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB/SPCB) से पंजीकृत एवं अधिकृत रीसाइक्लर्स या डिस्मेंटलर्स को ही ई-कचरा सौंपें। इस प्रकार अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Obsolete electronic equipment, computer hardware, and used batteries contain hazardous substances requiring environmentally safe handling. Financial guidelines mandate that e-waste disposal comply strictly with statutory E-Waste Management Rules. Consequently, public establishments must sell or transfer condemned electronic items exclusively to registered recyclers or authorized dismantlers holding valid environmental agency certifications.

question_english:
Arrange the following stages of condemning and disposing of an unserviceable government asset in the correct logical and procedural sequence under GFR 2017:
I. Handing over the item to the successful bidder and striking it off the stock ledger
II. Constitution of a Condemnation Board / Survey Committee
III. Inviting competitive bids or conducting a public auction for disposal
IV. Physical inspection and formal declaration of the item as unserviceable by the Committee
options_english: II, IV, III, I
IV, II, III, I
II, III, IV, I
III, II, IV, I
explanation_english:
Under GFR 2017 (Rules 217 to 220), the procedural sequence for asset condemnation and disposal is strictly defined: 
1. First, the competent authority constitutes a Condemnation Board / Survey Committee (Step II).
2. Second, the committee conducts physical inspection and submits its formal report declaring the asset unserviceable, obsolete, or beyond economic repair (Step IV).
3. Third, after competent authority sanction, competitive bids/tenders are invited or a public auction is conducted with a reserve price (Step III).
4. Fourth, upon receipt of full payment from the successful highest bidder, the item is physically released and officially struck off the stock register (Step I).
Therefore, the correct chronological sequence is II -> IV -> III -> I.
explanation_hindi:
जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 (नियम 217 से 220) के अंतर्गत सरकारी परिसंपत्तियों के कंडमनेशन और निपटान की एक निश्चित तार्किक और विधिक प्रक्रिया होती है:
1. सर्वप्रथम, सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा कंडमनेशन बोर्ड या सर्वेक्षण समिति का गठन किया जाता है (चरण II)।
2. इसके पश्चात समिति भौतिक निरीक्षण करके वस्तु को अनुपयोगी, अप्रचलित या मरम्मत योग्य न होने की औपचारिक रिपोर्ट देकर कंडम घोषित करती है (चरण IV)।
3. सक्षम स्वीकृति मिलने के बाद निपटान हेतु निविदाएं या सार्वजनिक नीलामी आयोजित की जाती है (चरण III)।
4. अंत में, उच्चतम बोलीदाता से पूर्ण धनराशि प्राप्त होने पर वस्तु उसे सौंपी जाती है तथा स्टॉक रजिस्टर से उसका अपलेखन कर दिया जाता है (चरण I)।
अतः सही क्रम II, IV, III, I है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) II, IV, III, I

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Disposing of unserviceable assets follows a strict chronological sequence. First, the competent authority constitutes a Condemnation Board. The board physically inspects the items and formally declares them unserviceable. Next, the department invites public bids or conducts an auction. Finally, upon receiving payment, the asset is handed over to the buyer and struck off registers.

question_english: When disposing of scrap or unserviceable materials through a public auction or competitive bidding, what preliminary financial exercise must the competent authority or evaluation committee determine prior to the sale?
options_english: Disburse advance commission to the auctioneer from the office cash imprest.
Determine a confidential reserve price or a realistic assessed scrap value.
Disclose the minimum acceptable floor price in the public newspaper advertisement.
Request the prospective buyers to determine the final valuation after taking delivery.
explanation_english: Under Rule 218 of GFR 2017 and standard government disposal manuals, before conducting a public auction or opening commercial bids for unserviceable stores, the competent authority/evaluation committee must determine a realistic assessed scrap value and establish a confidential 'Reserve Price'. Fixing a reserve price acts as an essential safeguard against bid-rigging, collusive cartelization among bidders, and distressed underselling of government property, ensuring that public assets are not sold below their true residual market worth.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 218 तथा सरकारी निपटान नियमावली के अंतर्गत, सार्वजनिक नीलामी या निविदा प्रक्रिया शुरू करने से पूर्व सक्षम प्राधिकारी अथवा मूल्यांकन समिति द्वारा सामग्री का यथार्थवादी अवशिष्ट मूल्य आंकते हुए एक गोपनीय 'आरक्षित मूल्य' (Reserve Price) निर्धारित करना अनिवार्य होता है। आरक्षित मूल्य तय करना सरकारी संपत्ति के संरक्षण हेतु एक महत्वपूर्ण वित्तीय सुरक्षा उपाय है, जिससे बोलीदाताओं के बीच सिंडिकेट या सांठगांठ (cartelization) को रोका जा सके और सरकारी संपत्ति को उसके उचित बाजार मूल्य से कम पर बिकने से बचाया जा सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Determine a reserve price or a reasonable assessed scrap value.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: assessed scrap value. Prior to disposing of scrap or unserviceable materials through public auction or tender, the competent authority or evaluation committee must determine a reserve price based on reasonable assessed scrap values. Setting a reserve price prevents the underselling of public property and provides a benchmark to evaluate incoming bids during disposal.

question_english: Which of the following represents a recognized exception to the general rule that condemned items must be sold through commercial bidding to generate public revenue?
options_english: Intact historic brass artifacts declared functionally obsolete by administrative executive orders.
Unserviceable government motor vehicles that have exceeded their prescribed operational lifespan.
Old broken wooden furniture items that can no longer be repaired for classroom use.
Highly classified, sensitive, or security documents that must be destroyed/shredded rather than sold publicly.
explanation_english: While GFR 2017 generally mandates that unserviceable assets and scrap be sold via tender or auction to realize revenue for the exchequer (Rule 218), Rule 222 and departmental security instructions provide an explicit exception for classified, secret, or confidential records, confidential examination materials (such as question papers/used answer sheets after prescribed retention periods), and security-sensitive items. To prevent breaches of national security, institutional confidentiality, or personal privacy, such documents must be pulped, shredded, or incinerated under the direct supervision of a gazetted officer, rather than offered for public sale or commercial recycling.
explanation_hindi: सामान्यतः जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 218 के तहत कंडम संपत्ति और कबाड़ को सार्वजनिक राजस्व अर्जित करने के लिए बेचा जाता है। किंतु जीएफआर के नियम 222 तथा सरकारी सुरक्षा नियमों के अनुसार अति गोपनीय, संवेदनशील या सुरक्षा संबंधी दस्तावेज (जैसे परीक्षा संबंधी गोपनीय अभिलेख, गोपनीय पत्राचार आदि) इसका अनिवार्य अपवाद हैं। गोपनीयता और सुरक्षा के उल्लंघन को रोकने के उद्देश्य से ऐसे संवेदनशील दस्तावेजों को व्यावसायिक रूप से बेचने के बजाय एक राजपत्रित अधिकारी की प्रत्यक्ष देखरेख में कतरकर (shredding), लुगदी बनाकर (pulping) या जलाकर नष्ट करना आवश्यक होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Highly classified or security documents which must be destroyed/shredded without public sale.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: must be destroyed/shredded without public sale. While condemned property is generally sold to generate public revenue, highly classified, sensitive, or security-restricted documents represent a clear exception. To prevent unauthorized disclosure of confidential information, security regulations require that such sensitive papers be destroyed or shredded under official supervision rather than offered for public sale or commercial recycling.

वार्षिक प्रदर्शन बोनस के रूप में सरकारी कर्मचारी के बैंक खाते में सीधे स्थानांतरित की जाने वाली धनराशि।

question_english: As defined under Chapter 9 of GFR 2017, what does the term "Grants-in-aid" primarily refer to?
options_english: Financial assistance provided by the government to autonomous bodies, NGOs, or institutions for specific approved purposes.
Funds transferred directly into a government employee's bank account as an annual performance-linked incentive.
Long-term monetary loans provided to agricultural farmers at highly subsidized concessional interest rates.
Direct capital flows from foreign institutional investors channeled into public infrastructure projects.
explanation_english: Under Chapter 9 (Grants-in-Aid and Loans) of GFR 2017 (Rules 228 to 230), 'Grants-in-aid' refers to non-repayable financial assistance sanctioned by central ministries and departments from the Consolidated Fund of India to autonomous bodies, universities, registered societies, Panchayati Raj institutions, NGOs, and educational institutions (such as government-aided schools). These grants are sanctioned for specific, approved developmental, educational, scientific, or social objectives, subject to predefined terms and conditions including adherence to auditing standards and the submission of formal Utilization Certificates.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के अध्याय 9 (सहायता अनुदान और ऋण) के नियम 228 से 230 के अनुसार, "सहायता अनुदान" (Grants-in-aid) से तात्पर्य भारत की संचित निधि से सरकारी मंत्रालयों द्वारा स्वायत्त निकायों, विश्वविद्यालयों, सहायता प्राप्त शिक्षण संस्थानों, गैर-सरकारी संगठनों (NGOs) या स्थानीय निकायों को विशिष्ट एवं स्वीकृत शैक्षणिक, सामाजिक या विकासात्मक उद्देश्यों की पूर्ति हेतु दी जाने वाली वित्तीय सहायता से है। यह अनुदान विशिष्ट शर्तों, लेखापरीक्षा (audit) और उपयोग प्रमाण पत्र (Utilization Certificate) प्रस्तुत करने की अनिवार्यता के अधीन प्रदान किया जाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Financial assistance provided to autonomous bodies, NGOs, or institutions for specific purposes.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: bodies, NGOs, or institutions for specific purposes. Under General Financial Rules, Grants-in- aid refer to financial assistance provided by government ministries to autonomous bodies, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, or local authorities. These grants support specific approved developmental, educational, cultural, or social objectives, subject to strict conditions regarding accounting, audited expenditure, and submission of utilization certificates.

question_english:
Consider the following standard conditions generally attached to Grants-in-aid sanctioned to institutions under GFR 2017:
I. The grantee institution must maintain regular accounts and subject them to statutory audit.
II. The grant must be utilized exclusively for the specific approved purpose for which it was sanctioned.
III. Unspent grant balances may be invested by the grantee in the stock market or speculative funds for commercial profit.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II
II and III
I and III
I, II and III
explanation_english: Under Rule 230 of GFR 2017, grants-in-aid are governed by stringent regulatory conditions: (1) The grantee institution must maintain proper accounts and submit audited statements of accounts (Rule 230(1) & (4)); (2) The grant must be utilized strictly and solely for the specific objective for which sanction was granted, and no diversion of funds to other heads is permissible without prior government approval (Rule 230(3)); (3) Public funds cannot be diverted into speculative investments or commercial ventures. Furthermore, Rule 230(8) mandates that interest earned on unspent grant balances must be mandatorily remitted to the Consolidated Fund of India or adjusted against future releases. Hence, Statements I and II are correct, while Statement III is illegal and incorrect.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 230 के अनुसार सहायता अनुदान कठोर वित्तीय शर्तों के अधीन होता है: (1) अनुदान प्राप्तकर्ता संस्था को उचित लेखा पुस्तकें रखनी होती हैं और उनका विधिवत ऑडिट (लेखापरीक्षा) कराना अनिवार्य है; (2) अनुदान का उपयोग केवल और केवल उसी स्वीकृत उद्देश्य के लिए किया जा सकता है जिसके लिए वह मंजूर किया गया था, और बिना पूर्व स्वीकृति के किसी अन्य मद में राशि का अंतरण (diversion) वर्जित है; (3) सार्वजनिक धन को शेयर बाजार या सट्टा बाजार में निवेश करना पूर्णतः गैर-कानूनी है। इसके अलावा, नियम 230(8) के तहत अप्रयुक्त राशि पर अर्जित ब्याज को भारत की संचित निधि में जमा कराना या अगले अनुदान में समायोजित करना अनिवार्य है। अतः कथन I और II सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Grants-in-aid are subject to strict conditions requiring grantee institutions to maintain audited accounting records and utilize funds exclusively for sanctioned public purposes. Investing unspent grant balances in speculative stock markets or private commercial ventures is strictly prohibited, as public grants must remain safeguarded and dedicated entirely to approved activities.

question_english: A government-aided school receives a capital Grant-in-aid from the Directorate of Education for constructing a science laboratory. By the end of the financial year, the civil construction is completed. What statutory document must the school submit to the Directorate to verify that the grant funds were utilized strictly for the sanctioned purpose?
options_english: A Utilization Certificate (UC)
An Expression of Interest (EoI) document
A Promissory Note
A Bank Guarantee
explanation_english: Under Rule 238 of GFR 2017, in respect of grants sanctioned for specific purposes or non-recurring capital expenditure, the grantee institution (such as a school) is legally required to submit a formal Utilization Certificate (UC) in the prescribed format (Form GFR 12-A / GFR 12-C). The UC serves as statutory accounting proof, certified by the Head of the Institution and audited by a Chartered Accountant or statutory auditor, confirming that the money was fully expended for the authorized purpose and that all stipulated sanction conditions were duly fulfilled.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 238 के अनुसार, किसी विशिष्ट प्रयोजन या पूंजीगत कार्य (जैसे विज्ञान प्रयोगशाला निर्माण) हेतु स्वीकृत अनुदान के संबंध में अनुदान प्राप्तकर्ता संस्था को निर्धारित प्रारूप (फॉर्म GFR 12-A / 12-C) में 'उपयोग प्रमाण पत्र' (Utilization Certificate - UC) प्रस्तुत करना अनिवार्य होता है। यह उपयोग प्रमाण पत्र इस बात का वैधानिक साक्ष्य होता है कि जारी की गई धनराशि का उपयोग पूरी तरह से उसी स्वीकृत उद्देश्य के लिए किया गया है तथा स्वीकृति पत्र में उल्लिखित सभी शर्तों का अक्षरशः पालन किया गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A Utilization Certificate (UC)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Upon completing a project funded by a public grant, the recipient institution must submit a formal Utilization Certificate to the sanctioning authority. The Utilization Certificate serves as statutory proof confirming that the grant funds were fully expended for the specific authorized purpose and in accordance with prescribed sanction conditions.

question_hindi:

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The release of subsequent installments of Grants-in-aid to an institution is generally conditional upon the submission and acceptance of the Utilization Certificate (UC) for the previous installment.
Reason (R): This statutory requirement ensures that previously sanctioned public funds have been genuinely utilized on the authorized objectives before committing further exchequer resources.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
explanation_english: Under Rule 238(1) of GFR 2017, no further grant or subsequent installment shall be released to any institution or organization unless the Utilization Certificate in respect of the previous grant/installment has been submitted to the satisfaction of the sanctioning administrative ministry or department. The core rationale of this financial rule is to maintain rigorous financial discipline, prevent parking of public funds in bank accounts, eliminate unspent surplus accumulation, and guarantee that previous public moneys have been legitimately spent on the intended objectives before committing additional government resources. Thus, Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are both true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 238(1) के अनुसार, किसी भी संस्थान या संगठन को सहायता अनुदान की अगली किस्त या नया अनुदान तब तक जारी नहीं किया जाएगा जब तक कि पिछली किस्त का उपयोग प्रमाण पत्र (UC) संतोषजनक रूप से प्रस्तुत न कर दिया गया हो। इस वित्तीय नियम का मुख्य उद्देश्य वित्तीय अनुशासन बनाए रखना, अनुदान प्राप्तकर्ता के खातों में सरकारी धन के अप्रयुक्त जमा (parking of funds) को रोकना तथा यह पुख्ता करना है कि अतिरिक्त सार्वजनिक संसाधन जारी करने से पहले पूर्व में आवंटित धनराशि का निर्धारित उद्देश्य हेतु वैध उपयोग हो चुका है। अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Releasing subsequent grant installments to an institution is generally contingent upon receiving a satisfactory Utilization Certificate for previous funds. This regulatory check ensures that prior allocations were properly expended on approved objectives before committing additional public funds, thereby maintaining financial control and preventing unspent balances from accumulating in grantee accounts.

question_english: According to Rule 238 of GFR 2017, within what statutory time frame must the Utilization Certificate in respect of a non-recurring grant be submitted by the grantee institution?
options_english: Within 3 months following the official closure of the financial year in which funds were received.
Within 12 months of the closure of the financial year in which the grant was released.
Within a period of 5 years counted strictly from the initial date of the formal grant sanction order.
There is no prescribed statutory time limit for submitting utilization certificates for non-recurring grants.
explanation_english: According to Rule 238(1) of GFR 2017, in respect of non-recurring grants (grants sanctioned for capital assets, construction, equipment procurement, etc.), the Utilization Certificate (UC) must be submitted by the grantee institution within 12 months of the closure of the financial year in which the grant was released. This statutory timeline allows the executing agency sufficient time to complete civil works or procurement and finalize audited financial statements, while ensuring government oversight and timely accounting of public expenditure.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर (GFR), 2017 के नियम 238(1) के अनुसार, अनावर्ती अनुदानों (Non-recurring grants - जैसे भवन निर्माण, प्रयोगशाला उपकरण खरीद आदि) के संबंध में अनुदान प्राप्तकर्ता संस्था द्वारा उपयोग प्रमाण पत्र (UC) उस वित्तीय वर्ष की समाप्ति के 12 महीने के भीतर प्रस्तुत किया जाना अनिवार्य है जिसमें अनुदान जारी किया गया था। यह समय-सीमा संस्था को निर्माण/क्रय कार्य पूरा करने और वार्षिक लेखापरीक्षा संपन्न कराने हेतु पर्याप्त समय प्रदान करती है तथा सार्वजनिक धन की समयबद्ध जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Within 12 months of closure of financial year in which grant was released.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: in which grant was released. General Financial Rules mandate that the Utilization Certificate for a non-recurring grant must be submitted within twelve months of the closure of the financial year in which the grant was released. Adhering to this statutory timeline ensures timely verification of project completion and proper accounting of public funds.

question_english: Under the General Financial Rules (GFR), in which standard prescribed format is the Utilization Certificate (UC) for non-recurring grants required to be submitted?

explanation_english: Under Rule 238(1) of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, Form GFR 12-A is the prescribed standard format for submitting Utilization Certificates (UC) in respect of non-recurring grants-in-aid sanctioned to autonomous bodies, grantee institutions, or local authorities. (Under the earlier GFR 2005 framework, Form GFR 19-A was used, which was updated to Form GFR 12-A in GFR 2017 for Autonomous Bodies and non-recurring grants, while Form GFR 12-C is used for other entities). Form GFR 12-A mandates grantee organizations to certify the total grants sanctioned, unspent balance brought forward, interest accrued on the grant funds, actual expenditure incurred on approved components, and unspent balance carried forward or surrendered. For educational administrators and school Principals managing government grants, adhering to Form GFR 12-A ensures statutory compliance and transparent accounting before requesting subsequent grant installments.
explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR) 2017 के नियम 238(1) के अनुसार, स्वायत्त निकायों, अनुदानग्राही संस्थाओं या स्थानीय प्राधिकरणों को स्वीकृत अनावर्ती सहायता अनुदान (non-recurring grants-in-aid) के संबंध में उपयोगिता प्रमाण पत्र (UC) प्रस्तुत करने के लिए फॉर्म जीएफआर 12-ए (Form GFR 12-A) मानक निर्धारित प्रारूप है। (पूर्ववर्ती जीएफआर 2005 में इसके लिए फॉर्म जीएफआर 19-ए था, जिसे जीएफआर 2017 में संशोधित किया गया)। फॉर्म जीएफआर 12-ए में अनुदानग्राही संस्था को स्वीकृत कुल अनुदान, गत वर्ष की अव्ययित शेष राशि, अनुदान पर अर्जित ब्याज, स्वीकृत मदों पर किया गया वास्तविक व्यय तथा अभ्यर्पित अथवा आगे ले जाई गई शेष राशि को विधिवत प्रमाणित करना होता है। विद्यालय प्राचार्यों और वित्तीय प्रशासकों के लिए अनुदानों की अगली किस्त प्राप्त करने हेतु फॉर्म 12-ए में समय पर उपयोगिता प्रमाण पत्र प्रस्तुत करना कानूनी रूप से अनिवार्य है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Form GFR 12-A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the General Financial Rules 2017 framework, Form GFR 12-A is the standard prescribed format for submitting Utilization Certificates for non-recurring grants. Grantee institutions must utilize Form GFR 12-A to detail total received grants, unspent balances, interest accrued, actual expenditure incurred, and formal certification of rule compliance.

स्वीकृति प्राधिकारी के पूर्व अनुमोदन से इसे आगामी वर्ष के सहायता अनुदान में समायोजित किया जा सकता है।

question_english: Which of the following statements regarding the unspent balance of a Grant-in-aid is INCORRECT under the General Financial Rules (GFR)?
options_english: The unspent grant balance must be mandatorily surrendered back to the Government consolidated account immediately.
It can be adjusted towards the grant-in-aid for the subsequent year with the prior approval of the sanctioning authority.
Details of the unspent balance and interest earned must be clearly indicated in the formal Utilization Certificate.
The grantee institution has an absolute right to utilize unspent funds for any unrelated project without prior approval.
explanation_english: Under GFR 2017 Rule 230(8) and Rule 238, grants-in-aid are sanctioned for specific, approved objects and schemes. Any unspent balance remaining at the close of the financial year must either be surrendered back to the Government (Consolidated Fund of India) or, with the specific prior approval of the sanctioning authority, adjusted against the grant-in-aid admissible for the subsequent financial year. Under Rule 230(8), all interest or other earnings against grants-in-aid released must also be mandatorily remitted to the Consolidated Fund of India and cannot be retained as additional resources. Under no circumstances does a grantee institution or autonomous body have any right to divert or utilize unspent grant balances for unrelated projects, unauthorized purposes, or other schemes without explicit sanction from the administrative Ministry.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 230(8) और नियम 238 के अनुसार, सहायता अनुदान विशिष्ट स्वीकृत उद्देश्यों और योजनाओं के लिए ही प्रदान किया जाता है। वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत में बची अव्ययित शेष राशि को या तो तुरंत भारत की संचित निधि (सरकारी खाते) में वापस समर्पित (surrender) किया जाना चाहिए अथवा स्वीकृति प्राधिकारी के विशिष्ट पूर्व अनुमोदन से अगले वित्तीय वर्ष के अनुदान में समायोजित किया जाना चाहिए। इसके अलावा, नियम 230(8) के तहत अनुदान पर अर्जित समस्त ब्याज भी अनिवार्य रूप से सरकारी खाते में जमा कराना होता है। अनुदानग्राही संस्था या किसी विद्यालय/निकाय को सक्षम प्राधिकारी की पूर्व स्वीकृति के बिना अव्ययित राशि को किसी असंबद्ध परियोजना या अनधिकृत कार्य में व्यय करने का कोई अधिकार नहीं है; अतः विकल्प D गलत कथन होने के कारण सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The grantee institution has absolute right to utilize unspent funds for any unrelated project without approval.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: utilize unspent funds for any unrelated project without approval. Unspent balances of grants-in-aid must be surrendered to the government or adjusted against future allocations with formal approval. Grantee institutions have no right to divert unspent public funds to unrelated projects or unauthorized activities without explicit sanction, as grant usage is strictly bound by original sanction terms.

question_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR) के अंतर्गत निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रयोजन के लिए सहायता अनुदान (Grants-in-aid) की स्वीकृति पूर्णतः वर्जित (NOT permissible) है?

question_english: For which of the following purposes is the sanctioning of Grants-in-aid strictly NOT permissible under the General Financial Rules (GFR)?
options_english: To enable an NGO to pay off commercial loans taken for speculative real estate business.
For promoting art, culture, literature, and educational development initiatives across various states.
For the annual operational and capital maintenance of an autonomous scientific research institute.
For effectively implementing and monitoring a specific approved central sector development scheme.
explanation_english: Under Chapter 9 (Grants-in-aid and Loans) of GFR 2017 (Rules 228 to 232), grants-in-aid can be sanctioned only to recognized autonomous bodies, registered societies, cooperatives, local bodies, or reputed voluntary organizations for bona fide public purposes such as education, science and technology, cultural activities, healthcare, or authorized developmental schemes. Under the Cannons of Financial Propriety (Rule 21) and statutory grant principles, public funds cannot be sanctioned to discharge speculative private debts, commercial liabilities, or real estate business loans of non-governmental organizations. Sanctioning grants for speculative private gain is illegal, ultra vires, and a severe breach of public trust.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के अध्याय 9 (सहायता अनुदान और ऋण, नियम 228 से 232) के तहत, सहायता अनुदान केवल मान्यता प्राप्त स्वायत्त निकायों, पंजीकृत सोसायटियों, स्थानीय निकायों या प्रतिष्ठित स्वयंसेवी संगठनों को प्रामाणिक सार्वजनिक कल्याणकारी उद्देश्यों जैसे शिक्षा, विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी, कला-संस्कृति, अथवा स्वीकृत विकासात्मक योजनाओं के लिए ही स्वीकृत किया जा सकता है। वित्तीय औचित्य के सिद्धांतों (नियम 21) के अनुसार सार्वजनिक धन का उपयोग किसी निजी गैर-सरकारी संगठन के सट्टा संबंधी रियल एस्टेट ऋणों या वाणिज्यिक देयताओं के भुगतान के लिए बिल्कुल नहीं किया जा सकता। ऐसा अनुदान प्रदान करना अवैध और वित्तीय अनुशासन का घोर उल्लंघन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) To enable an NGO to pay off commercial loans taken for speculative real estate business.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: loans taken for speculative real estate business. Grants-in-aid are intended for public welfare, educational development, research, and approved social welfare schemes. Sanctioning public grants to enable private organizations or non-governmental entities to settle commercial loans incurred from speculative private real estate ventures is strictly illegal and violates fundamental financial propriety and grant allocation regulations.

question_hindi: वित्तीय शक्ति प्रत्यायोजन नियमावली (DFPR) और GFR के संदर्भ में "वित्तीय शक्तियों का प्रत्यायोजन" (Delegation of Financial Powers) पद से क्या तात्पर्य है?

question_english: What does the term "Delegation of Financial Powers" refer to in the context of the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR) and GFR?
options_english: Centralizing all financial decision-making authority exclusively at the level of the Prime Minister's Office.
The legal devolution and transfer of financial decision-making and sanctioning authority to subordinate authorities to facilitate prompt administration.
The formal administrative process of surrendering unspent budget allocations to the Ministry of Finance.
Transferring surplus government revenue funds into private commercial banks to earn higher interest rates.
explanation_english: Under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 1978 and Rule 22 of GFR 2017, the "Delegation of Financial Powers" refers to the statutory process by which the President of India (or the Ministry of Finance) delegates specific financial sanctioning authorities to administrative Ministries, Heads of Departments (HoD), and Heads of Offices (HoO) / Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs), such as school Principals. The objective is to decentralize operational decision-making, prevent administrative bottlenecks, and empower field officers to execute sanctioned schemes, contingent expenditures, and procurements efficiently within prescribed monetary limits and budgetary allocations, while holding them accountable for compliance with financial rules.
explanation_hindi: वित्तीय शक्ति प्रत्यायोजन नियमावली (DFPR), 1978 तथा जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 22 के तहत, "वित्तीय शक्तियों का प्रत्यायोजन" उस विधिक प्रक्रिया को संदर्भित करता है जिसके द्वारा राष्ट्रपति अथवा वित्त मंत्रालय प्रशासनिक मंत्रालयों, विभागाध्यक्षों (HoD) तथा कार्यालयाध्यक्षों (HoO) / आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारियों (DDO) जैसे कि विद्यालय प्राचार्यों को विशिष्ट वित्तीय स्वीकृति अधिकार सौंपते हैं। इसका प्राथमिक उद्देश्य निर्णय प्रक्रिया का विकेंद्रीकरण करना, प्रशासनिक विलंब को दूर करना और क्षेत्रीय अधिकारियों को निर्धारित मौद्रिक सीमाओं और बजट आवंटन के भीतर आकस्मिक व्यय, खरीद और योजनाओं के कार्यान्वयन के लिए अधिकृत करना है, साथ ही वित्तीय उत्तरदायित्व भी सुनिश्चित करना है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) The legal transfer of financial decision- making authority to subordinate authorities to facilitate administration.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: making authority to subordinate authorities to facilitate administration. Delegation of financial powers involves the administrative transfer of financial sanctioning authority from central authorities to subordinate administrative officers. This delegation decentralizes decision-making, expedites routine administrative workflows, prevents operational bottlenecks, and improves administrative efficiency while enforcing financial accountability within established monetary thresholds and statutory regulatory guidelines.

question_hindi:
वित्तीय शक्ति प्रत्यायोजन नियमावली (DFPR) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. शक्तियां स्वीकृत बजट प्रावधानों की उपलब्धता के अधीन प्रत्यायोजित की जाती हैं।

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR):
I. Powers are delegated subject to the availability of sanctioned budget provisions.
II. A delegated authority can further sub-delegate its financial powers to any lower authority at its own discretion without formal regulatory approval.
III. Delegated powers must be exercised in strict accordance with the general financial principles and cannons of financial propriety.
IV. Sanctioning of expenditure is strictly limited to the quantum and ceiling of power delegated.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and III
I, III and IV
II, III and IV
I, II, III and IV
explanation_english:
Under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR) and GFR 2017:
1. Statement I is correct: Rule 3 of DFPR explicitly states that all financial powers delegated to any authority are subject to the condition that funds are available under the relevant sanctioned budget head.
2. Statement II is incorrect: Under the legal principle 'delegatus non potest delegare' and DFPR provisions, a subordinate authority to whom financial power is delegated cannot further sub-delegate that power to another lower authority at its own discretion unless expressly empowered to do so by general or special orders of the delegating competent authority.
3. Statement III is correct: All delegated authorities must exercise their powers with due regard to the Cannons of Financial Propriety (GFR Rule 21) and statutory accounting rules.
4. Statement IV is correct: The power to incur expenditure or issue sanctions cannot exceed the specific financial ceiling or scope delegated to that post.
Therefore, Statements I, III, and IV are correct.
explanation_hindi:
वित्तीय शक्ति प्रत्यायोजन नियमावली (DFPR) और GFR 2017 के अनुसार:
1. कथन I सही है: DFPR के नियम 3 में स्पष्ट उल्लेख है कि प्रत्यायोजित शक्तियों का प्रयोग संबंधित बजट शीर्ष में पर्याप्त निधि की उपलब्धता के अधीन ही किया जा सकता है। बिना बजट कोई व्यय स्वीकृत नहीं हो सकता।
2. कथन II गलत है: प्रशासनिक विधि के मान्य सिद्धांत ('delegatus non potest delegare') के अनुसार, जिस प्राधिकारी को शक्तियां प्रत्यायोजित की गई हैं, वह सक्षम प्राधिकारी के स्पष्ट आदेशों या नियमों के बिना अपने स्वविवेक से उन शक्तियों को किसी अन्य अधीनस्थ प्राधिकारी को उप-प्रत्यायोजित नहीं कर सकता।
3. कथन III सही है: वित्तीय शक्तियों का प्रयोग वित्तीय औचित्य के सिद्धांतों (GFR नियम 21) और स्थापित वित्तीय नियमों के अनुसार ही किया जाना अनिवार्य है।
4. कथन IV सही है: व्यय की स्वीकृति प्रत्यायोजित मौद्रिक सीमा और अधिकार क्षेत्र के भीतर ही दी जा सकती है।
अतः कथन I, III और IV सही हैं (विकल्प B सही है)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, III and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Delegated financial powers must be exercised strictly within approved budget allocations, monetary limits, and general financial principles. An authority delegated financial power cannot sub-delegate those powers to lower officials at personal discretion without explicit regulatory authorization or formal approval from higher competent authorities under delegation rules.

question_hindi: एक विद्यालय प्राचार्य को प्रति अवसर 20,000 रुपये तक आकस्मिक व्यय (contingent expenditure) स्वीकृत करने की वित्तीय शक्ति प्रत्यायोजित है। विद्यालय में तत्काल 45,000 रुपये के अनुमानित नलकारी (प्लंबिंग) एवं स्वच्छता मरम्मत कार्य की आवश्यकता है। उच्च प्राधिकारी से स्वीकृति मांगने से बचने तथा कार्य में तेजी लाने के लिए, प्राचार्य उसी कार्य के लिए एक ही दिन 15,000 रुपये के तीन अलग-अलग स्वीकृति आदेश जारी करते हैं। क्या यह प्रशासनिक कार्रवाई न्यायोचित है?
options_hindi: नहीं, उच्च सक्षम प्राधिकारी की स्वीकृति प्राप्त करने से बचने के लिए मांग या व्यय को विभाजित (splitting) करना वित्तीय नियमों के तहत सख्त वर्जित है।
हाँ, यह विद्यालय के अति आवश्यक परिचालन संबंधी मुद्दों को हल करने में प्रशासनिक दक्षता और पहल को प्रदर्शित करता है।
हाँ, बशर्ते कि कुल संचयी व्यय विद्यालय के स्वीकृत वार्षिक बजट आवंटन से अधिक न हो।
नहीं, क्योंकि छोटे मरम्मत और प्लंबिंग कार्य को कानूनी रूप से आकस्मिक व्यय शीर्ष के तहत वर्गीकृत नहीं किया जा सकता है।

question_english: A school Principal has delegated financial power to sanction contingent expenditure up to Rs. 20,000 per occasion. The school requires immediate plumbing and sanitation repair work estimated at Rs. 45,000. To expedite the work without seeking sanction from the higher authority, the Principal issues three separate sanction orders of Rs. 15,000 each on the same day for the same work. Is this administrative action justified?
options_english: No, splitting demand or expenditure to avoid obtaining the sanction of a higher competent authority is strictly prohibited under financial rules.
Yes, it demonstrates administrative efficiency and initiative in resolving urgent school operational issues.
Yes, provided that the total cumulative expenditure does not exceed the sanctioned annual budget allocation for the school.
No, because minor repair and plumbing work cannot be legally classified under the contingent expenditure head.
explanation_english: Under Rule 157 of GFR 2017 and standard provisions of DFPR, a demand for goods, services, or execution of works shall not be divided or split into small quantities or multiple sanctions merely to evade the necessity of obtaining the sanction of higher authority required with reference to the estimated value of the total demand. Here, the estimated cost of the plumbing work is Rs. 45,000, which exceeds the Principal's delegated ceiling of Rs. 20,000. Splitting this single requirement into three sanctions of Rs. 15,000 each on the same day constitutes an intentional circumvention of financial rules and is an irregularity liable to audit objection and disciplinary action under Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 157 और DFPR के सुस्थापित प्रावधानों के अनुसार, कुल मांग के अनुमानित मूल्य के संदर्भ में अपेक्षित उच्च प्राधिकारी की स्वीकृति प्राप्त करने की आवश्यकता से बचने के लिए मांग, सेवाओं या कार्यों को छोटे टुकड़ों या एकाधिक स्वीकृतियों में विभाजित (splitting of sanction) नहीं किया जाएगा। प्रस्तुत मामले में, प्लंबिंग कार्य का कुल अनुमानित व्यय 45,000 रुपये है, जो प्राचार्य की 20,000 रुपये की प्रत्यायोजित वित्तीय सीमा से अधिक है। एक ही दिन एक ही कार्य के लिए 15,000 रुपये की तीन अलग-अलग स्वीकृतियां जारी करना वित्तीय नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन और वित्तीय अनियमितता है, जिस पर लेखापरीक्षा आपत्ति और अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई की जा सकती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) No, splitting demand to avoid obtaining sanction of higher authority is prohibited.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: sanction of higher authority is prohibited. Issuing multiple smaller financial sanctions on the same day for a single work requirement to bypass monetary limits assigned to higher competent authorities is strictly prohibited. Splitting financial demands violates delegation rules. Procuring officers must seek formal sanction from the higher authority holding appropriate monetary sanctioning powers for the total project cost.

question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है।
अभिकथन (A): कोई प्रशासनिक प्राधिकारी अपने अधीनस्थ अधिकारी को अपनी वित्तीय शक्तियां तब तक उप-प्रत्यायोजित (sub-delegate) नहीं कर सकता, जब तक कि विधिक नियमों या सक्षम प्राधिकारी के आदेश द्वारा ऐसा करने के लिए स्पष्ट रूप से अधिकृत न किया गया हो।

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): An administrative authority cannot sub-delegate its financial powers to a subordinate officer unless expressly authorized to do so by statutory rules or an order of the competent authority.
Reason (R): Sub-delegation dilutes financial accountability, and the original delegating authority must maintain an unbroken chain of fiscal responsibility.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
explanation_english:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
- Assertion (A) is correct: Under administrative law and the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), the legal maxim 'delegatus non potest delegare' (a delegate cannot further delegate) strictly applies to financial sanctions. A Head of Department or Head of Office cannot redelegate financial powers to subordinate officials without explicit statutory backing or sanction from the Ministry of Finance / Competent Authority.
- Reason (R) is correct and explains (A): The constitutional and statutory purpose of restricting sub-delegation is to preserve a clear, unbroken line of accountability. If financial powers could be casually passed down, accountability for financial propriety and budgetary control would become diffused, leading to fiscal indiscipline and audit lapses. Hence, (R) provides the direct institutional rationale for (A).
explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
- अभिकथन (A) सही है: प्रशासनिक विधि और DFPR के तहत 'प्रत्यायोजित प्राधिकारी आगे प्रत्यायोजन नहीं कर सकता' (delegatus non potest delegare) का सिद्धांत सख्ती से लागू होता है। वित्तीय शक्तियां प्राप्त कोई अधिकारी सक्षम प्राधिकारी या नियमों के स्पष्ट आदेश के बिना अपनी वित्तीय शक्तियां निचले अधिकारियों को नहीं सौंप सकता।
- कारण (R) सही है और (A) की सटीक व्याख्या करता है: उप-प्रत्यायोजन पर प्रतिबंध लगाने का मूल उद्देश्य वित्तीय उत्तरदायित्व की स्पष्ट श्रृंखला बनाए रखना है। यदि शक्तियों को स्वेच्छा से नीचे हस्तांतरित करने की अनुमति दी जाए, तो सार्वजनिक धन के उपयोग की जवाबदेही धुंधली हो जाएगी और वित्तीय अनियमितताओं की संभावना बढ़ जाएगी। अतः (R), (A) का सही कारण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: correct explanation of (A) Financial authority cannot be sub-delegated to lower officers unless explicit regulatory provisions or formal orders permit such transfer. Restricting sub-delegation ensures clear lines of administrative responsibility, prevents dilution of financial accountability, and guarantees that expenditure sanctions remain strictly within authorized supervisory controls across government establishments.

question_hindi: वित्तीय शक्ति प्रत्यायोजन नियमावली (DFPR) और सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR) के अंतर्गत, किसी मंत्रालय या विभाग से संबद्ध एकीकृत वित्तीय सलाहकार (IFA / FA) की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या होती है?

question_english: Under the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR) and General Financial Rules (GFR), what is the primary role of the Integrated Financial Adviser (IFA / FA) attached to a Ministry or Department?
options_english: To act as the primary drawing and disbursing officer for processing monthly salary disbursements across the Ministry.
To physically disburse cash payments and petty allowances to all registered commercial vendors and contractors.
To write and evaluate the Annual Confidential Performance Appraisal Reports of all teaching staff in the state.
To provide financial scrutiny, concurrence, and advice to the Secretary and competent administrative authorities before they exercise delegated financial powers.
explanation_english: Under the Scheme of Integrated Financial Adviser (IFA) outlined in GFR and DFPR, the Financial Adviser (FA) is integrated with the administrative Ministry to assist the Secretary (who is the Chief Accounting Authority) in budget formulation, expenditure control, scheme evaluation, and financial decision-making. The primary role of the FA is to provide expert financial advice, ensure observance of financial propriety and GFR rules, and accord financial concurrence before the competent administrative authority exercises financial powers on proposals beyond delegated powers of lower officers or requiring IFA consultation. The FA does not perform cash disbursement or routine DDO clerical duties, but acts as the internal financial conscience and fiscal guardian of the Ministry.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर और DFPR के तहत एकीकृत वित्तीय सलाहकार (IFA) योजना के अनुसार, वित्तीय सलाहकार (FA) प्रशासनिक मंत्रालय के सचिव (जो मुख्य लेखा प्राधिकारी होते हैं) को बजट निर्माण, व्यय नियंत्रण, योजनाओं के मूल्यांकन और वित्तीय निर्णय लेने में सहायता प्रदान करता है। FA की प्राथमिक भूमिका वित्तीय नियमों की संवीक्षा करना, वित्तीय औचित्य और GFR के नियमों का पालन सुनिश्चित करना तथा सक्षम प्रशासनिक प्राधिकारी द्वारा शक्तियों का प्रयोग करने से पूर्व वित्तीय सहमति (concurrence) और सलाह देना है। FA का कार्य नियमित नकद संवितरण या DDO का कार्य करना नहीं है, बल्कि मंत्रालय में वित्तीय अनुशासन और राजकोषीय नियंत्रण बनाए रखना है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) To provide financial concurrence and advice before competent authority exercises delegated powers.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: before competent authority exercises delegated powers. The Financial Adviser attached to a Ministry or Department provides financial scrutiny, advice, and concurrence before competent administrative authorities exercise delegated financial powers. The Financial Adviser evaluates expenditure proposals for propriety, rule compliance, and budget availability, assisting administrative heads in maintaining overall fiscal discipline and effective budget management.

question_english: In the administrative hierarchy of financial management under GFR 2017, what is the primary function of a "Controlling Officer"?
options_english: To act as the principal constitutional statutory auditor for auditing all expenditures of the Union and State Governments.
To directly manage and allocate foreign exchange reserves in consultation with international financial agencies.
To exercise continuous administrative supervision ensuring that expenditures incurred by subordinate disbursing officers remain within the sanctioned budget grants and are properly justified.
To formally review and approve all legislative financial bills presented in Parliament for enactment into law.
explanation_english: Under Rule 2(xii) and Rules 52 to 64 of GFR 2017 (Control of Expenditure), a "Controlling Officer" is an officer entrusted by a Ministry or Head of Department with the responsibility of controlling the incurring of expenditure and/or the collection of revenue by subordinate Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs). The Controlling Officer's duties include: (1) ensuring that expenditure does not exceed the budget grant under each unit of appropriation; (2) verifying that expenditure is incurred in public interest and backed by proper sanctions and vouchers; (3) conducting monthly reconciliation of figures with the Pay and Accounts Office (PAO); and (4) surrendering anticipated savings in time to prevent budgetary lapses.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 2(xii) और नियम 52 से 64 (व्यय का नियंत्रण) के अंतर्गत, "नियंत्रक अधिकारी" (Controlling Officer) वह अधिकारी होता है जिसे मंत्रालय या विभागाध्यक्ष द्वारा अधीनस्थ आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारियों (DDOs) द्वारा किए जाने वाले व्यय और राजस्व संग्रह के नियंत्रण की जिम्मेदारी सौंपी जाती है। नियंत्रक अधिकारी के प्राथमिक कर्तव्यों में यह सुनिश्चित करना शामिल है कि व्यय स्वीकृत बजट अनुदान से अधिक न हो, व्यय नियमों और औचित्य के अनुसार किया गया हो, वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) के साथ मासिक आंकड़ों का मिलान (reconciliation) किया जाए, तथा संभावित बचतों को समय पर समर्पित किया जाए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) To ensure expenditure of disbursing officers is kept within budget grant and properly justified.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: kept within budget grant and properly justified. A Controlling Officer is tasked with administrative supervision over drawing and disbursing officers within their administrative hierarchy. The controlling officer's primary function is to continuously monitor expenditure trends, verify bill justifications, ensure expenses remain strictly within allocated budget grants, and prevent unauthorized expenditure or budget overruns across subordinate offices.

question_hindi: सार्वजनिक वित्तीय प्रबंधन का कौन-सा मूलभूत सिद्धांत यह निर्धारित करता है कि किसी प्रत्यायोजित प्राधिकारी द्वारा तब तक कोई व्यय नहीं किया जा सकता या वित्तीय देयता उत्पन्न नहीं की जा सकती, जब तक कि उसके लिए कोई विशिष्ट स्वीकृत बजट प्रावधान न हो?

question_english: Which fundamental principle of public financial management dictates that no expenditure can be incurred or liability committed by a delegated authority unless there is a specific sanctioned budget provision for it?
options_english: Rule of E-procurement and digital financial processing
Rule on Budgetary Control (No expenditure without budget provision)
Rule of Contingency management and emergency funds allocation
Rule of Advance Payment to commercial contractors and vendors
explanation_english: Under Article 114(3) of the Constitution of India and Rule 52 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, no expenditure can be incurred from the Consolidated Fund of India unless it is covered by a specific budget appropriation authorized by Parliament. This cardinal rule of Budgetary Control ('No expenditure without budget') stipulates that no administrative or delegated authority—including school Principals and DDOs—can issue expenditure sanctions, enter into contracts, or make payments in excess of the sanctioned budget grant or without an existing budget allotment under the relevant accounting head. Sanctioning expenditure in anticipation of funds without budget provision violates financial rules and attracts disciplinary liability.
explanation_hindi: भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 114(3) तथा सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR) 2017 के नियम 52 के तहत, भारत की संचित निधि से तब तक कोई व्यय नहीं किया जा सकता जब तक कि संसद द्वारा पारित विशिष्ट विनियोग या बजट प्रावधान न हो। बजटीय नियंत्रण का यह मूलभूत सिद्धांत ('बिना बजट प्रावधान के कोई व्यय नहीं') निर्धारित करता है कि कोई भी प्रशासनिक या प्रत्यायोजित प्राधिकारी (जैसे विद्यालय प्राचार्य या DDO) स्वीकृत बजट आवंटन के अभाव में न तो कोई व्यय स्वीकृत कर सकता है, न अनुबंध कर सकता है और न ही भुगतान कर सकता है। बजट प्रावधान के बिना भविष्य में धन मिलने की प्रत्याशा में व्यय स्वीकृत करना वित्तीय नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Rule on Budgetary Control (No expenditure without budget)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: without budget) A foundational rule of public financial management dictates that no expenditure can be incurred and no financial liability created unless funds have been formally authorized through specific budget provisions. Budgetary control rules mandate that availability of budget grants is a mandatory prerequisite before any financial sanction or payment commitment is made.

question_english: If an unexpected operational emergency arises in a government school requiring an expenditure of Rs. 5 Lakhs (which is substantially beyond the Principal's delegated financial sanctioning power), what is the correct administrative procedure to be followed?
options_english: The Principal should spend the required amount directly from student welfare or Vidyalaya Kalyan Samiti (VKS) funds without informing higher authorities.
The Principal should temporarily borrow the required money from personal contributions of the school teaching staff and reimburse them later.
The Principal should immediately issue a public tender and award the contract without obtaining any prior administrative sanction.
The Principal must submit a comprehensive proposal justifying the emergency along with preliminary estimates to the higher competent authority for administrative and expenditure sanction.
explanation_english: Under DFPR and GFR 2017 Rules 22 and 62, a government officer or Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO), such as a school Principal, is bound strictly by the financial ceilings assigned to their post. Even in an emergency, an officer cannot exceed their financial powers, divert tied student welfare funds, borrow private money, or award contracts without prior administrative approval. The only legally valid administrative course of action is to prepare an urgent detailed proposal outlining the nature of the emergency, justification, scope of work, and estimated expenditure, and submit it immediately to the higher competent authority (such as the Directorate of Education / Deputy Director / District Education Officer) who possesses the requisite financial sanctioning powers.
explanation_hindi: DFPR और GFR 2017 के नियम 22 तथा 62 के अनुसार, कोई भी सरकारी अधिकारी या DDO (जैसे विद्यालय प्राचार्य) अपने पद को प्रत्यायोजित वित्तीय सीमाओं से बंधा होता है। किसी आपात स्थिति में भी कोई अधिकारी अपनी शक्तियों का अतिक्रमण नहीं कर सकता, न ही छात्र कल्याण/वीकेएस निधि का अनधिकृत विचलन कर सकता है और न ही कर्मचारियों से निजी तौर पर धन उधार ले सकता है। सही और विधिक प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया यह है कि प्राचार्य आपात स्थिति की प्रकृति, औचित्य और अनुमानित लागत का विस्तृत प्रस्ताव तैयार करें और उसे प्रशासनिक एवं वित्तीय स्वीकृति के लिए उच्च सक्षम प्राधिकारी (जैसे शिक्षा निदेशालय/उप शिक्षा निदेशक) को तत्काल अग्रेषित करें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The Principal must submit a proposal justifying emergency to higher competent authority for sanction.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: justifying emergency to higher competent authority for sanction. When an administrative requirement or emergency expenditure exceeds an officer's delegated financial sanction limit, the officer cannot approve the expense or bypass rules. The correct procedure requires preparing a comprehensive proposal detailing the emergency, justifying the scope of work, and submitting it to the higher competent authority possessing appropriate financial powers for sanction.

question_english: What is the primary purpose and scope of the Internal Audit mechanism established within government departments under GFR 2017?
options_english: To provide independent, objective assurance and consulting activity designed to improve operational governance and internal financial controls.
To physically arrest, suspend, and prosecute government servants who commit minor procedural lapses in office administration.
To prepare, compile, and print the comprehensive Union Budget document for presentation in Parliament.
To automatically write off all unrecoverable financial losses and audit disallowances incurred by the department.
explanation_english: Under Rule 65 to Rule 68 of GFR 2017, Internal Audit is an independent, objective assurance and consulting activity designed to add value and improve an organization's operations. Functioning under the Chief Controller of Accounts / Financial Adviser, the internal audit wing assists the administrative management in accomplishing its objectives by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, internal controls, governance processes, and compliance with statutory financial rules. It helps identify system weaknesses, billing errors, and procedural non-compliance proactively before external statutory audit by the CAG.
explanation_hindi: जीएफआर 2017 के नियम 65 से 68 के तहत, आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा (Internal Audit) एक स्वतंत्र, वस्तुनिष्ठ आश्वासन और परामर्शीय गतिविधि है जिसे संगठन के कार्यों में मूल्य संवर्धन और सुधार करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। मुख्य लेखा नियंत्रक (CCA) और वित्तीय सलाहकार के अधीन कार्य करते हुए आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा विंग जोखिम प्रबंधन, आंतरिक वित्तीय नियंत्रण, सुशासन प्रक्रियाओं और वित्तीय नियमों के अनुपालन की प्रभावशीलता का व्यवस्थित मूल्यांकन करता है। इसका प्राथमिक उद्देश्य सीएजी (CAG) द्वारा की जाने वाली बाह्य वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा से पहले प्रणालीगत कमियों और प्रक्रियात्मक त्रुटियों की पहचान कर उन्हें समय पर सुधारना है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) To provide independent, objective assurance and consulting activity to improve operations.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: and consulting activity to improve operations. Internal audit under the General Financial Rules provides independent, objective evaluation and assurance regarding an organization's financial operations. It systematically evaluates internal controls, financial systems, and compliance mechanisms, assisting administrative heads in detecting irregularities, safeguarding assets, ensuring accounting accuracy, and improving overall operational efficiency and governance standards.

question_hindi:
किसी सरकारी विभाग में आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा (Internal Audit) के निम्नलिखित उद्देश्यों पर विचार कीजिए:

II. लागू वित्तीय नियमों, विनियमों और कार्यकारी आदेशों के अनुपालन का सत्यापन करना।
III. भारत के नियंत्रक एवं महालेखापरीक्षक (CAG) द्वारा की जाने वाली बाह्य वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा के पूर्ण विधिक विकल्प के रूप में कार्य करना।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?

केवल II और III

question_english:
Consider the following objectives of an Internal Audit in a government department:
I. To evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal accounting and financial controls.
II. To verify compliance with applicable financial rules, regulations, and executive orders.
III. To act as a complete legal substitute for the external statutory audit conducted by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
explanation_english:
Under GFR 2017 Chapter 3 (Internal Audit):
- Statement I is correct: A fundamental objective of internal audit is to appraise the soundness, adequacy, and application of internal accounting, financial, and operational controls.
- Statement II is correct: Internal audit reviews and verifies whether departmental operations, sanctions, and procurements comply with applicable GFR rules, Treasury rules, and government instructions.
- Statement III is incorrect: Internal audit is an internal managerial appraisal tool functioning under the Department's Chief Controller of Accounts. It can NEVER substitute the external statutory audit conducted independently by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) under Articles 148, 149, and 151 of the Constitution of India. Both audits serve complementary functions, but external statutory audit by CAG is sovereign, independent, and constitutionally mandated.
Therefore, Statements I and II only are correct.
explanation_hindi:
जीएफआर 2017 के अध्याय 3 (आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा) के अनुसार:
- कथन I सही है: आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा का मूल उद्देश्य आंतरिक लेखांकन, वित्तीय और परिचालन नियंत्रणों की पर्याप्तता और प्रभावशीलता का मूल्यांकन करना है।
- कथन II सही है: यह सत्यापित करता है कि कार्यालय के वित्तीय लेन-देन, स्वीकृतियां और खरीद प्रक्रियाएं स्थापित जीएफआर नियमों और सरकारी निर्देशों के अनुरूप हैं।
- कथन III गलत है: आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा विभाग का एक आंतरिक प्रबंधकीय तंत्र है जो मुख्य लेखा नियंत्रक के अधीन कार्य करता है। यह भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 148, 149 और 151 के तहत भारत के नियंत्रक एवं महालेखापरीक्षक (CAG) द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से की जाने वाली बाह्य वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा का विकल्प कभी नहीं हो सकता। सीएजी की लेखापरीक्षा एक संवैधानिक दायित्व है।
अतः केवल कथन I और II सही हैं (विकल्प A सही है)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Internal audit serves to assess the effectiveness of internal financial controls and verify compliance with established rules, procedures, and statutory guidelines. It operates as an internal managerial oversight mechanism and is not a substitute for external statutory audits conducted independently by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India.

question_hindi: प्रधान लेखा कार्यालय (Principal Accounts Office) से एक आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा दल विद्यालय के खातों के निरीक्षण हेतु आता है। दल पिछले तीन वित्तीय वर्षों के मध्याह्न भोजन योजना (पीएम पोषण / PM POSHAN) के रोकड़ बही (कैश बुक), सहायक रजिस्टरों और व्यय वाउचरों की जाँच करने की मांग करता है। इस स्थिति में विद्यालय प्राचार्य का क्या कर्तव्य है?
options_hindi: मांगे गए सभी खाता-बही, रजिस्टर और वाउचर तुरंत उपलब्ध कराने चाहिए, क्योंकि आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा को सभी सरकारी वित्तीय लेन-देन की जाँच करने का विधिक अधिदेश प्राप्त है।
पीएम पोषण अभिलेखों के निरीक्षण से यह कहते हुए इनकार कर देना चाहिए कि मध्याह्न भोजन निधि केंद्रीय योजना अनुदान है जो विभागीय आंतरिक लेखापरीक्षा के क्षेत्राधिकार से बाहर है।
लेखापरीक्षा दल को निर्देश देना चाहिए कि वे सीएजी (CAG) द्वारा बाह्य वैधानिक लेखापरीक्षा संपन्न होने के बाद ही आएं।
केवल वर्तमान चालू वित्तीय वर्ष से संबंधित अभिलेख और वाउचर ही प्रस्तुत करने चाहिए।
